<!--PLEASE DO NOT MAKE ACKBAR'S LEAD IN QUOTE "IT'S A TRAP!" IT DETAILS NOTHING ABOUT ACKBAR'S CHARACTER.-->
'''Gial Ackbar''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Mon Calamari]] veteran [[soldier]] and prominent revolutionary leader during the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[Cold War]], and the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[Resistance]] and the [[First Order]]. Throughout his sixty [[Standard year|years]] of service, Ackbar was regarded as a brilliant tactician.

Ackbar hailed from the [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]] and served as the [[captain]] of the [[Mon Calamari Guard]]. During the Clone Wars, Ackbar fought in the [[Battle of Mon Cala]], in which he helped to secure [[Prince]] [[Lee-Char]]'s ascent as [[King of Mon Cala]] and repel the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire]], Ackbar became the foremost military [[Commanding officer|commander]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], emerging as a symbol of defiance against the Empire's subjugation of non-[[human]]s. His presence attracted Mon Calamari support for the Alliance, thus supplying the [[MC80 Star Cruiser|Mon Calamari star cruisers]] that made up a bulk of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]].

From his command ship of ''[[Home One]]'', [[Supreme fleet commander|supreme commander]] Ackbar acted as the fleet commander during the [[Battle of Endor]], in which the Alliance successfully mounted an attack that led to the destruction of the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] and the [[death]] of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. After the Battle of [[Endor]], the Alliance formed the [[New Republic]]. Ackbar became a [[Fleet Admiral|fleet admiral]] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] and led the New Republic to its victory over the Empire during the [[Battle of Jakku]]. After the battle on [[Jakku]] ended, the Empire retreated into the [[Unknown Regions]] and Ackbar retired to Mon Cala.

By [[34 ABY]], the emerging threat of the First Order, which arose from the ashes of the Empire, led Princess [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to form the Resistance without the support of the New Republic that had turned a blind [[eye]] to the First Order. Organa, the [[general]] of the Resistance, coaxed Ackbar out of his retirement to serve in the Resistance. After reclaiming his commission as an [[Admiral]], Ackbar served in the [[Resistance base]] on [[D'Qar]], where he helped oversee the [[Battle of Starkiller Base|battle]] to destroy the First Order [[superweapon]] known as [[Starkiller Base]].

Ackbar was later present on the bridge of the Resistance's [[flagship]] the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] when the Resistance [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuated]] from D'Qar, but he was killed when two First Order [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s, as well as [[Kylo Ren's TIE silencer|Kylo Ren’s TIE silencer]] [[Battle of Oetchi|attacked]] the ship after it exited [[hyperspace]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:Dac-AORCR.png|thumb|right|175px|Ackbar was born on Mon Cala]]
Gial Ackbar was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[Ocean|aquatic]] [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]] during the final [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Ultimate">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> Ackbar worked as [[Coral City]]'s representative on the [[Calamari Council]].<ref name="The Rebel Alliance" /> Eventually, he enlisted into military service to the [[Mon Calamari Guard]], which was tasked with protecting Mon Cala's monarchs and dignitaries.<ref name="Everything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> Ackbar eventually worked his way through the ranks of the guard, and became its [[captain]]; therefore, he also became the chief military [[advisor]] to the leader of the ocean world.<ref name="Ultimate" />

===The Clone Wars===
====Captain of the Mon Calamari Guard====
{{Quote|Soldiers of Mon Calamari: This is your ''home!'' Do ''not'' let it fall!|Ackbar, to his troops|<ref name="Water War" />}}
[[File:MonCalamariCity-WW.png|thumb|left|250px|Mon Cala's capital city, where Ackbar lived and served.]]
[[King]] [[Yos Kolina]] ruled Mon Cala during the [[Clone Wars]], between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic]]. The war subsequently came to Mon Cala when Separatist [[Riff Tamson]] secretly assassinated Kolina,<ref name="Water War" /> which was left a shocking crime<ref name="NR DB">{{Databank|nossor-ri|Nossor Ri}}</ref> that threatened to provoke a civil war on the planet. Members of the [[Quarren Isolation League]], which was led by [[Chief]]tan [[Nossor Ri]], pushed for a Quarren to take the throne instead of the current heir, the young [[Prince]] [[Lee-Char]].<ref name="Water War" /> Ackbar, as the captain of the Mon Cal Knights, became Lee-Char's protector and his chief military protector.<ref name="TCW:CE" /> In the [[Coral City|Mon Calamari capital]], a meeting was soon held, where [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]] attended as representatives to the Republic.<ref name="Water War" />

However, the Quarren isolationists ensured Tamson— one of [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s many Separatist enforcers— was present as well. The Quarren dignitaries voiced that they did not want Lee-Char as their king because he was too young and inexperienced. As the debates went on, what the Quarren did want became clear: a Quarren king, not another Mon Calamari ruler. Lee-Char assured the Quarren that he was dedicated to serving both races in a mutually beneficial way, Tamson, however, ordered him to cease speaking, as he had not "earned the right." Ackbar rushed in and reminded the [[Karkarodon]] that he had no say, as he was just an observer for the Confederacy. Ri then said that the Quarren, their argument not agreed to, were done with the negotiations and exited.<ref name="Water War" />

Ackbar, Skywalker, and Amidala reported into the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]], specifically [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]], aboard a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)|Republic frigate]], where Ackbar informed the council that a civil war on Mon Cala was inevitable. Yoda, therefore, in order to keep Mon Cala aligned with the Republic, dispatched a company of [[clone SCUBA trooper]]s, Jedi [[Kit Fisto]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], to bolster the defenses of the Mon Calamari. Ackbar then met with Mon Cala's senator in the [[Galactic Senate]], [[Meena Tills]], who officially assigned Ackbar to protect Lee-Char during the forthcoming battle. Ackbar, however, thought it foolhardy to take the prince onto the battlefront, as he was too inexperienced in combat, though, he gave in, as it was a longstanding tradition for the monarch of Mon Cala to lead the soldiers into battle.<ref name="Water War" />

[[File:Epguide401.png|thumb|right|270px|Ackbar leads the charge against the Separatists.]]
Later, Lee-Char addressed the gathered troops, telling them he did not believe the Quarren intended to attack, but before he finished, the Quarren army attacked, along with Separatist [[AQ-series battle droid]]s led by Tamson; prompting Ackbar to proclaim "It's an attack." Ackbar and Skywalker quickly rallied their forces to defend the city, held true to Till's will and took the prince to the front lines. Ackbar then led the charge into the enemy ranks and ordered his troops not to let their [[homeworld]] fall to the confederacy. The fighting continued, and soon thereafter, Yoda came through: The Republic's reinforcements arrived. Ackbar moved back to the prince's position, handed him a [[Blaster spear|blaster]], telling him to earn the respect of the people; he had to lead the fight. Lee-Char, realizing the wisdom in Ackbar's words, began to rally their forces.<ref name="Water War" />

====Civil war on Mon Cala====
The gamble soon paid off when the droids and Quarren retreated to their [[transport]]s. Ackbar voiced to the Jedi that they had won the first assault. Tills, thinking they had completely defeated the Separatists, told Lee-Char to start dictating for the Separatists' surrender. Ackbar halted Till's hasty assumptions; the first wave had been beaten, not the battle. However, just then, dozens of massive [[cyborg]] [[Hydroid Medusa]]s descended upon the city. The seemingly invincible [[jellyfish]] swept their tentacles through the [[clone trooper]]s and Mon Calamari, electrocuting many. More droids materialized from behind, and as they were outmatched, Ackbar told the prince it was time to retreat. The pair agreed that the caves on the ocean floor were the safest place, so they fled to the caves. Once there, Lee-Char expressed his concern that his father would have been disappointed in him for the failures that he had befallen during the day's events. Ackbar, however, assured the young prince that Kolina would have been proud of his son.<ref name="Water War" />

[[File:Ackbar_contacts_the_Jedi.png|thumb|left|250px|Ackbar, Fisto, Skywalker, and Amidala request reinforcements from the Jedi Council.]]
While regrouping in the caves, the Jedi Council was contacted in order to arrange the deployment of more Republic soldiers. However, before an agreement could be reached, the Council's signal was [[Jammer|jammed]], leaving Ackbar and the others unsure if the Council planned to send reinforcements. Ackbar and Skywalker agreed that it was likely troops would be sent, but Lee-Char believed they would arrive too late to do any good against the Confederacy. Taking the lead, Lee-Char devised a way to escape the planet: take the Republic frigate on the water's surface to [[Coruscant]], the Republic's [[capital]]. The plan was agreed on, so the group began the ascent to the surface. A plethora of enemy troops stood in their path, so Fisto diverted the enemy forces and sent down several [[One Man Submersible Devilfish]] to expedite the ascent.<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref>

However, as they neared the ship, it exploded and the debris rained down over Ackbar and the others. Skywalker told the others to grab onto the debris so it could pull them back down to the ocean floor. Ackbar did so, and as they fell, he voiced that they should split up into two teams to better protect the true location of the prince. Lee-Char agreed, and Ackbar told him to be careful, as he was Mon Calamari's last hope. The prince then went with Tano, Fisto, and the clones, while Ackbar's group, Amidala, Skywalker, and Tills, planned to disrupt the city's communications, which would prevent Tamson from knowing that Republic reinforcements were incoming until it was too late for him to mount a proper counterattack.<ref name="Gungan Attack" />

Ackbar, Skywalker, and Tills headed to the city's [[Mon Cala central planetary scanner mast|central planetary scanner mast]] to topple it. Skywalker used [[the Force]] to cause it to collapse while Ackbar defended him from aqua droids. The group retreated after the mission succeeded. However, Tamson correctly deduced that the scanner mast alone had been targeted because Republic reinforcements were forthcoming. Therefore, he launched another attack. Ackbar and the others fought the Separatist soldiers in order to keep their attention on them, rather than searching for the prince. Ackbar and the others were soon surrounded by Hydroid Medusas, but were saved when the Republic reinforcements arrived: A [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] deployed members of the [[Gungan Grand Army]] from Naboo—who, like the Mon Calamari and Quarren, were amphibians.<ref name="Gungan Attack" />

====Counter-attack====
The [[Gungan]]s attacked using their traditional weapons—[[booma]]s and [[atlatl]]s— whose [[plasma]]-based technologies disabled the Hydroid Medusas, droids and Quarren alike, and freed Ackbar, Tills, and Skywalker, who joined the turning tide of the battle. A Separatist [[Trident-class assault ship|''Trident''-class assault ship]] soon arrived and began spinning; creating a vortex that confused the battlefront and scattered soldiers on both sides. Ackbar grabbed on to Skywalker, swam him to the [[gunship]], and threw him up to it. Skywalker severed one of its legs with [[Skywalker lightsaber|his lightsaber]], causing the craft to spin out of control and crash. However, with their surge in forces nullified, the Republic-aligned troops were taken [[prisoner]] by the Separatists.<ref name="Gungan Attack" />

[[File:AckbarPrisoners.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Captain Ackbar was rescued by Lee-Char.]]
Ackbar, his troops and the clones were taken to a prison camp on the ocean floor, while Tamson personally interrogated Skywalker, Amidala, and Fisto. Tano and the prince, however, managed to elude capture again, but Lee-Char thought to rally the forces—Mon Calamari, Gungan, clone, Jedi, and even Quarren—to all together overwhelm Tamson and his droids. He infiltrated the prison camp Ackbar was detained in to ask his guidance. Ackbar and Tills rejoiced when they saw the prince alive, but were confounded when Lee-Char explained his daring plan to reunify the citizens of Mon Cala against the Separatist invaders. Ackbar was shocked that the prince would ally himself with the people who had killed his father, but Lee-Char told Ackbar that he knew for a fact that Tamson had done so. Tano added that she had seen similar occurrences of Dooku manipulating a planet's people to start a civil war, so the prince said that he would find and show Ri the truth. Ackbar agreed to the prince's noble plan and said he would marshal the Mon Calamari troops for battle. Lee-Char also gave the captain his signal of when to attack: when a Quarren attacked a Separatist. Just then, a legion of aqua droids appeared and put the prince under arrest. Lee-Char willingly went with his captors in order to confront Ri and show him the truth.<ref name="Prisoners" />

[[File:AckbarGunganPrisoners.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Ackbar swims alongside a Gungan and a clone.]]
Later, Lee-Char was sentenced to death by Tamson and ordered that all the prisoners be taken to the capital to witness the execution. Tamson's Karkarodon enforcers surrounded the prince while Tamson read aloud the prince's crimes against the Separatist state. Meanwhile, Ackbar and the other prisoners watched from the side. One of Ri's aides materialized and handed Ackbar his [[Battle baton|baton]] and informed him that Lee-Char's boldness had worked: Ri and the Quarren had agreed to expel the Confederates and reclaim Mon Cala. Ackbar looked across the plaza and nodded to Ri. The Quarren soldiers quietly distributed arms to the clones and troops, while Ri swam across the plaza, created an ink cloud, and grabbed the prince. Ackbar's troops opened fire on the Separatists and the battle raged once more. Ackbar charged the aqua droids, leading the battle from his side, while Lee-Char proved himself by leading the rest of the forces and killing Tamson, a fearsome warrior—thereby freeing Mon Cala. Ackbar, the Jedi, and Ri rushed to the young prince and congratulated him.<ref name="Prisoners" />

Some time later, Ackbar attended Lee-Char's [[Coronation of Lee-Char|coronation]] as the king of Mon Cala, like his father had once done. Ackbar stood to the right of the ceremonial throne, witnessing Ri's pledge of allegiance of the Quarren to King Lee-Char, and Lee-Char likewise pledged his loyalty to all the people of Mon Cala.<ref name="Prisoners" />

===Imperial Era===
====Defending Mon Cala====
=====Prelude to battle=====
[[File:DacPalaceInterior-2017DarthVader13.png|thumb|right|220px|Commander Ackbar listening to Ambassador Tevlar's proposals]]
In [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Occ">According to ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', the [[invasion of Mon Cala]] took place in [[18 BBY]].</ref> Ackbar held the rank of [[commander]] as the [[Chief of Security]] for King Lee-Char. During the first year of the [[Imperial Era]], Lee-Char had come under the influence of a [[Jedi]] Padawan named [[Ferren Barr]]. Barr helped Lee-Char defy the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] in their trade negotiations, which garnered the attention of [[Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. Palpatine sent [[Darth]] Vader to handle the Jedi, and he had [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] park the ''[[Sovereign]]'' above Mon Cala.<ref name="Dark Lord 13" />

As the negotiations in [[Dac City]] with Tarkin's [[ambassador]] [[Telvar]] went nowhere, Darth Vader,<ref name="Dark Lord 13" /> three<ref name="Dark Lord 14" /> [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]], and a squad of [[Purge Trooper|elite]] clone troopers arrived at Dac City. Upon their arrival, Ackbar stopped the Inquisitors and demanded their business. The [[Ninth Sister]] gave Ackbar an Imperial writ legally stopping anyone from bringing any harm to her and the other two inquisitors. Commander Ackbar, thinking it to be outrageous, refused to give any ground, even when Darth Vader stepped in. Vader told him that he was looking for an enemy of the Empire. Ackbar continued to insist that King Lee-Char was involved in peaceful negotiations, nothing more. However, Telvar's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|shuttle]], which had been taking off nearby, exploded. Vader used this to accuse Ackbar of the attack being the fault of the Mon Calamari. Above the planet, Tarkin informed [[Major]] [[Rantu]] that the deployment of landing craft would commence immediately.<ref name="Dark Lord 13" />

=====The conflict=====
[[File:Ackbar-2017DarthVader14.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gial Ackbar with Lee-Char and Raddus]]
Vader then took his Inquisitors to find King Lee-Char, whom he expected would know where the Jedi was. A [[Battle of Dac City|battle]] broke out in Dac City. Meanwhile, Lee-Char, Ackbar, [[Raddus]], and a few other Quarren and Mon Calamari observed how the battle was going. Ackbar reported that the defenders were holding their own, but that the Empire had landed substantial forces on all of the above-ground land. He also noted that the Mon Calamari were not at their best above the waves. Lee-Char hoped to hold the Imperials until the evacuation was complete, although only fifty percent of civilians had been moved below water by that point.<ref name="Dark Lord 14">[[Darth Vader (2017) 14|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 14]]</ref>

Lee-Char then spoke with Governor Tarkin, begging him to withdraw the attack. Tarkin maintained that it was the Mon Calamari who had provoked the Empire with the murder of Telvar and that they would only cease the violence if Lee-Char allowed him to "investigate." Lee-Char, knowing that an investigation was closer to an invasion, threatened Tarkin with an aggressive defense. Tarkin warned the king to stop fighting and then ended the call.<ref name="Dark Lord 14" />

Lee-Char then got on a call with Ackbar and Raddus, instructing the former to defend the northern hemisphere and the latter the southern. Ackbar inquired what the king would do, and Lee-Char answered that he planned to make an address to his people. However, just as he signed off with Ackbar and Raddus, Vader and his Inquisitors arrived. Right as Vader began to use the Force on Lee-Char to get him to reveal the location of the Jedi, many [[Unidentified Mon Cala creature|creatures]] emerged from the sea and destroyed the above-ground cities. The waves produced by this destruction even caused Vader to fall into the sea, and he was not able to respond to Tarkin's comm requests.<ref name="Dark Lord 14" />

[[File:MonCalaCraft-2017DarthVader15.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ackbar rides a vehicle.]]
Vader was eventually able to escape the ocean and was rescued by his Inquisitors, although he insisted to them that he never needed rescue. Lee-Char was rescued, by a group of Quarren in a submarine. Above the ground, [[Colonel]] [[Bergon]] reported to Tarkin that they were making progress, but just as Tarkin warned her not to underestimate Raddus, Commander Ackbar and a number of Mon Calamari rode in on [[Unidentified Mon Calamari aquatic vehicle|aquatic vehicles]] with Ackbar leading the [[Attack on Bergon's sky-base|charge]], crying out "For the King! For Mon Cala!" Bergon sent in her [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE Fighters]]. Ackbar waited for the TIEs to get closer, and then gave the signal to emerge out of the water.<ref name="Dark Lord 15">[[Darth Vader (2017) 15|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 15]]</ref>

The vehicles' missiles fired at the TIEs and Bergon's platform, penetrated the shields, and destroyed the platform. Ackbar was taken to where Lee-Char was. Both of them thought that Lee-Char would have died. Ackbar explained that they had been able to take down one of the sky-bases, but the Empire would bring more. Lee-Char told Ackbar that they would fight until the Empire withdrew and that he would save his people. Ackbar, skeptical of this, asked if this was Lee-Char's words or the Jedi's. This reminded him of Barr, who in the meantime was being hunted by Vader and his Inquisitors. Vader, at this point, took his Inquisitors and purge troopers to confront Barr, who was eventually killed. Raddus was able to launch a group of [[Star Cruiser]]s to help evacuate Mon Calamari. The cruisers, which had originally been merchant vessels, had been refitted for combat.<ref name="Dark Lord 16">[[Darth Vader (2017) 16|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 16]]</ref>

Nevertheless, the result of the battle ended up being a victory for the Empire.<ref name="Victory">''[[Star Wars: Aliens of the Galaxy]]''</ref> After the invasion, Commander Ackbar fled Mon Cala to serve the Rebellion against the Empire, which he did loyally.<ref name="Altaya1">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star}}</ref> Like Raddus, he joined the nascent [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> At some point, Ackbar was [[Slavery|enslaved]] by Grand Moff Tarkin, but was later saved by the rebels.<ref name="Force Collection">{{ForceCollection|Admiral Ackbar|star=5}}</ref> Ackbar was injured in the [[Battle of Boz Pity (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Boz Pity]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rebel Alliance}}</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
====Battle at Fostar Haven====
{{Quote|The commanders verified the distress signal from Fostar Haven.|Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Squadrons">''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Ackbar_commanding_from_hologram.png|250px|thumb|left|Admiral Ackbar giving orders via hologram]]
The [[Battle of Scarif]] of [[1 BBY]]<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> marked the beginning of open warfare between the Alliance and Empire—a conflict remembered as the [[Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Battles" />—and saw the death of Admiral Raddus. In the wake of Raddus's death, Ackbar assumed command over the still-growing [[Alliance Military]],<ref name="BC Endor">{{BustCollectionCite|36|Star Wars Universe}}</ref> including command over the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]]<ref name="Battles" /> under the title of [[Supreme fleet commander|supreme commander]].<ref name="On the Front Lines">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref>

After the [[destruction of Alderaan]] at the hands of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], a [[Gial Ackbar's fleet|fleet]] under the command of Ackbar received a [[distress signal]] from [[Alderaanian refugee convoy|Alderaanian refugees]] [[Battle at Fostar Haven|attempting]] to flee from the Empire, which wanted to wipe away whatever remained of the fallen planet. In response, Ackbar first sent [[Echo Squadron]], but ended up sending three CR90 corvettes, a Nebulon-B frigate, and the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser]] [[Aurora (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Aurora'']] to help the refugees after he was convinced by [[Lindon Javes]] that they needed more help.<ref name="Squadrons" />

====Evacuating Yavin 4====
{{Quote|Move it along, soldiers! The clock is ticking! Every moment we ''dawdle'' broadens the ''targets'' on our backs! Let's ''go''!|Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Princess Leia 1">[[Princess Leia 1|''Princess Leia'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:RebelsEvacuateGreatTemple-PrincessLeia1.png|thumb|right|250px|Ackbar ordering rebel personnel to keep moving]]
Following the [[Battle of Yavin]], which saw the destruction of the Death Star in a major victory for the rebellion,<ref name="Battles" /> the Empire set out to attack the Rebel base. Ackbar was among the Rebel leaders in charge of getting the fleet together to help with the evacuation.<ref name="Princess Leia 1" /> Ackbar stayed with the fleet once the evacuation had been completed.<ref name="HC 1">{{HelmetCollectionCite|1|Databank A-Z}}</ref> [[Colonel]] [[Anj Zavor]] made contact with Ackbar and what remained of the fleet after the [[Battle of Scarif]], although Ackbar later said<ref name="The Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> in [[34 ABY]]<ref name="Date TRF">The reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' establishes that the [[in-universe]] artifact ''[[The Rebel Files]]'' was buried on the same [[Standard day|day]] as the [[Battle of Endor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]]. Given that the former also states that ''The Rebel Files'' was rediscovered thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the battle, the artifact must have been found and annotated in [[34 ABY]].</ref> that they were "Shorthanded, behind schedule, under-equipped, and hardly in a position to supplant Raddus and bolster the rebel fleet."<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

He helped organize the troops and gather the supplies on the planet for evacuation. During the chaos, Ackbar ran into [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]]. He gave his condolences regarding the Destruction of Alderaan while at the same time ordering troops where to bring supplies. He informed her where [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] was, whom she had been looking for.<ref name="Princess Leia 1" />

====Mission to Rodia====
{{Quote|It was a somewhat successful trip. Artoo has the full catalog of Rodian weapons–''"<br />"''Excellent.|Luke Skywalker and Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Heir to the Jedi">''[[Heir to the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
In [[0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Heir to the Jedi]]'' to [[0 ABY]].</ref> Ackbar sent Lieutenant [[Luke Skywalker]] along with [[R2-D2]] on a [[Mission to Rodia (Luke Skywalker)|mission]] to [[Rodia]]. Although the objective of the mission was to open new supply lines for the rebellion, Ackbar was uncomfortable with calling it [[Smuggler|smuggling]]. The mission had been the idea of Princess Leia, who suggested that the [[Chekkoo clan]] would be open to working with them. While Mon Mothma was at first unsure of the idea, when Ackbar supported it, the decision was made. Skywalker noted while he was on the mission that no one seemed to want to challenge Ackbar.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />

====Mission to Fex====
{{Quote|It's possible that the moon might make an ideal base for the Alliance, so I want you to scout it with that in mind.|Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />}}
[[File:BrazilianHeirtotheJedi-FullCoverArt.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker and Kelen find that Fex is very inhospitable]]
When Skywalker returned, Admiral Ackbar and Princess Leia took a shuttle to the command ship ''[[Redemption]]''. He began to explain how the mission went, but Ackbar cut him off, uninterested. He was more curious about what happened to Skywalker in the [[Llanic system]], where he had shot down two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]]. Organa began to explain a new [[Mission on Denon|mission]], which would have the goal of extracting the [[cryptologist]] [[Drusil Bephorin]] and bringing her to see her [[Drusil Bephorin's husband|family]] on [[Omereth]], which Ackbar explained was out past [[Hutt Space]]. Ackbar commented that it was an ocean planet, which looked delightful to him, if not for the large and hungry native fish. When Skywalker inquired why he was the one being assigned the mission, Organa explained that a talented [[pilot]] would be needed.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />

The [[Sakhet's son|Kupohan]] he had saved had been carrying valuable information that revealed the whereabouts of a [[Givin]] [[cryptologist]] named [[Drusil Bephorin]] who the rebellion wished to extract. Skywalker, who had been planning to use the ''[[Desert Jewel]]'', asked for it to receive a weapons upgrade, but Ackbar told him that the Alliance was low on money, and had to focus its resources on maintaining the fleet, and not upgrading it. Skywalker suggested that he ask [[Nakari Kelen]] for help as her [[Fayet Kelen|father]] was very rich, and was told by Ackbar that she had returned from her training mission. Ackbar did not object to this plan.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />

Once Kelen had returned, she began to converse with Skywalker, with Admiral Ackbar standing nearby. She told him of her father's plan to [[Mission to Fex|investigate]] a new [[Fex|moon]] his scouts had discovered. Although Kelen did not think that her father would give money for upgrades for nothing, she speculated that he might exchange the funds for a scouting report on the [[moon]], which Kelen thought she and Skywalker could do. Ackbar then cut in, asking if the Empire knew about Fex and the planet it orbited, [[Sha Qarot]], as well as if any sentient species lived there. Kelen was unsure about the former but told Ackbar there were no sentient species that she knew of. Ackbar gave them permission to go but also asked that they keep a lookout to see if the moon would make a good base for the Alliance. Skywalker then bade farewell to Ackbar.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />

====Mission on Denon====
{{Quote|A Kupohan who occasionally does contract work for the Bothan spynet and others runs a small noodle hut as a front for her intelligence services.|Admiral Ackbar briefs Luke Skywalker and Nakari Kelen|<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />}}
[[File:Luke_defends_Drusil.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Luke Skywalker defends Drusil Bephorin with his lightsaber.]]
When Skywalker returned, the fleet was still hiding in the [[Pantora system|Orto Plutonia system]]. When he and Kelen met Ackbar in the ''[[Promise]]'', Ackbar was disappointed to hear that Fex would never be able to house a rebel base, but he was encouraged to hear that the ''Desert Jewel'' had been upgraded. He then began to brief the pair on their new [[Mission on Denon|mission]]. He explained that their [[Sakhet|contact]] ran a [[Sakhet's Noodles|noodle hut]] on the planet [[Denon]] as a front for her spy work. They would go to this [[restaurant]] and order something strange to indicate what they were looking for.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />

Upon Ackbar's forgetting of the strange dish, the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] reminded him that it was the [[Corellian buckwheat noodles]] with [[rancor sauce]]. Ackbar and Kelen both found this dish appalling. Organa assured them that they would not need to eat it, just order it. Sakhet, the shop's owner, would have files ready for them when they arrived. Ackbar told them that their target, Bephorin, wanted to be taken to [[Omereth]], where the Alliance was arranging for her family to be brought. Ackbar warned that she would be heavily guarded and that the guards may need to be "taken care of." The mission ended up being successful, but Kelen, to the great regret of Skywalker, was killed.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />

Shortly after the Mission on Denon, Rebel forces managed to [[Bombing of the Imdaar supply base|bomb an Imperial supply base]] on [[Imdaar]] and a [[Bombing of the Kuat shipyards|shipyard]] on [[Kuat]]. Ackbar informed Leia Organa of this sometime after the events occurred.<ref name="Skywalker Strikes, Part IV" />

[[File:AllianceHighCommand-2015StarWars9.png|thumb|left|200px|Admiral Ackbar discussed Luke Skywalker's rescue with General Dodanna and Mon Mothma]]
Sometime later, on an Alliance warship, Rebel commanders received a [[distress signal]] from [[R2-D2]]. Ackbar, Mon Mothma, and General Dodonna learned that Skywalker had been captured by a [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]]. Ackbar inquired how they could rescue Skywalker, although Mon Mothma regretfully stated that she was unwilling to put out the resources to rescue him. Mothma also began to say that she had no idea who would even volunteer for such a task, but she was interrupted by a [[Shyriiwook|growl]] from Chewbacca, which was translated by C-3PO to mean that the pair would [[Rescue of Luke Skywalker|leave]] at once.<ref name="Star Wars 9">[[Star Wars (2015) 9|''Star Wars'' (2015) 9]]</ref>

====Hijacking the ''Harbinger''====
{{Quote|The people of Tureen VII have been secretly providing aid to the rebellion. Now it's up to us to return the favor.|Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Star Wars 23">[[Star Wars (2015) 23|''Star Wars'' (2015) 23]]</ref>}}
[[File:AdmiralAckbar-2015StarWars23.png|thumb|right|250px|Admiral Ackbar suggested bringing support to the planet of Tureen VII]]
In [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Date Harbinger">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars (2015) 23|''Star Wars'' (2015) 23]] to [[0 ABY]].</ref> the planet [[Tureen VII]] came under [[Siege on Tureen VII|siege]] by the Empire for secretly providing aid to the Rebel Alliance. When Ackbar, Mothma, and Dodonna learned of these events, Ackbar suggested that the Alliance return the favor by providing help to their people, who were starving. When Princess Leia and Lieutenant Skywalker suggested taking such action, Mothma explained that three previous attempts had been unable to penetrate the planet's [[blockade]] or its swarms of TIE fighters. Skywalker suggested that they would need something big to barrel through, but this was shot down by Mothma, who explained that the Rebel fleet could not be spared.<ref name="Star Wars 23" />

Skywalker clarified, saying he did not mean the fleet, but in fact a [[Star Destroyer]]. Organa thought that he was crazy, and Dodonna felt the plan to be preposterous, but Ackbar thought that it could work, suggesting that a crew, as well as an Admiral, take command. Mothma gave them permission to proceed, and the [[Hijacking of the Harbinger|mission]] would be carried out.<ref name="Star Wars 23" /> The attempt was successful.<ref name="Star Wars 22">[[Star Wars (2015) 22|''Star Wars'' (2015) 22]]</ref>

====Mutiny on Mon Cala====
{{Expandsect}}
{{Quote|Ackbar to all ships. Protect the fleet.|Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Star Wars 49">[[Star Wars (2015) 49|''Star Wars'' (2015) 49]]</ref>}}
[[File:Rebelfleetarrives-SW201549.png|thumb|left|200px|Under Ackbar's leadership, more rebel ships join the mutiny against the Empire.]]
After the [[battle for Jedha]], Leia, Luke, [[Han Solo]], C-3PO, [[R2-D2]], [[Chewbacca]], and Ackbar met with [[Regent]] [[Dors Urtya]] to discuss the possibility of the [[Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet]] rebelling against the Empire and joining the Rebel navy. Urtya declined out of fear for the people of Mon Cala.<ref name="Star Wars 44">[[Star Wars (2015) 44|''Star Wars'' (2015) 44]]</ref>

Ackbar was present on a starship when he and the rest of the fleet received a message from the dying King Lee-Char asking his people to join the Alliance before he was killed by [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="Star Wars 48">[[Star Wars (2015) 48|''Star Wars'' (2015) 48]]</ref> From the bridge of a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari starship|Mon Calamari starship]], Ackbar led the fleet along with Rebel Alliance support to mutiny against the Imperial forces sent to stop them. Ackbar contacted Captain [[Pysk Lila]] of the ''[[Aurora Flare]]'' and asked if she would volunteer to crash her [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|cruiser]] full of [[coaxium]] into a Star Destroyer in order for the fleet to escape, knowing that she would lose her life in the process. Lila agreed to the tactic, and Ackbar told her that he wished he could have gotten to know her more. The ''Aurora Flare'' crashed into the Star Destroyer causing a hole to form in the Imperial blockade and for the Mon Calamari cruisers to escape. Ackbar and the rest of the Mercantile Fleet fled to [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]] where they would be outfitted into warships for the Rebel Navy.<ref name="Star Wars 49" />

====Assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks====
[[File:AckbarBringingHope-2015StarWars53.png|thumb|right|200px|Ackbar ordering starfighters to scramble and restoring hope into his crew.]]
Ackbar was present at the Mako-Ta Space Docks when the Rebel Alliance tried to start a party to celebrate their new fleet. But their party was cut short by the arrival of Darth Vader's [[Death Squadron]] who were secretly contacted by [[Queen]] [[Trios]]. Because the cruisers had been sabotaged by Trios, the Death Squadron started to pick off each cruiser one by one. Luke Skywalker did manage to get past the [[Shu-Torun]] codes used to shut down the cruisers and launch the rebel starfighters.<ref name="Star Wars 50">[[Star Wars (2015) 50|''Star Wars'' (2015) 50]]</ref> Luke used the light trail from his ship to signal to Ackbar that the bay doors were open. Ackbar ordered all his fighters to launch and spread the word.<ref name="Star Wars 53">[[Star Wars (2015) 53|''Star Wars'' (2015) 53]]</ref> After getting the codes needed to bring all the ships online, Ackbar ordered the ''Home One'' to launch into hyperspace.<ref name="Star Wars 55">[[Star Wars (2015) 55|''Star Wars'' (2015) 55]]</ref>

====Prior to Shu-Torun====
{{Quote|The Rebellion is in no position to start a major offensive.|Admiral Ackbar|<ref name="Star Wars 61">[[Star Wars (2015) 61|''Star Wars'' (2015) 61]]</ref>}}
[[File:AckbarLeiaDiscussing-2015StarWars61.png|thumb|left|250px|Ackbar asking Leia about her plan for the assault on Shu-Torun.]]
After an [[Attack on an Imperial Impound Yard|attack]] on an [[Imperial Impound Yard]], Skywalker offered [[Tula Markona]] and [[Clan Markona|her clan]] if they wanted to go up to the ''Home One'' and meet Admiral Ackbar, but Tula refused to because she was still upset that Skywalker and [[Heroes of Yavin|his team]] indirectly caused the deaths of her [[parent]]s.<ref name="Star Wars 61" />

The team traveled to the [[Kaliida Nebula]] in the ''[[Volt Cobra]]'' and were initially worried that they were in a trap when Ackbar and the ''Home One'' did not come by to pick them up. The ''Home One'' eventually arrived to pick them up when Ackbar's voice was heard over the [[comlink]], relieved to know that they had survived the assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks. Princess Leia went up to the bridge to talk with the Admiral, who was very delighted to see her. After greeting her, the Princess told Ackbar that she had several documents that would allow them to destroy Shu-Torun, the homeworld of Queen Trios. Ackbar was very reluctant and skeptical to use a large rebel force to allow Leia to pursue her personal vendetta against the Queen of Shu-Torun. The Mon Calamari admiral asked how she planned to do this, to which Leia told him that she had a plan they would never expect.<ref name="Star Wars 61" />

====Working with Rogue Squadron====
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Commander Skywalker'' instructed you to catalogue the comms-logs, not fly off to Force knows where.''"<br />"''But you don't understand ''Admiral Ackbar.'' This is ''important.''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''More important than ''following orders?'' Seems Rogue Leader was right to clip your wings. Back to the flight deck this instant!|Ackbar and Ibti Myrak|<ref name="SWA 11">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=11|story=Squad Goals, Part One}}</ref>}}
[[File:Ackbar_shoved.png|thumb|right|245px|Stewer was shoved into Ackbar by Myrak]]
After the [[Attack in the Cilpar system|attack]] in the [[Cilpar system]], ambitious rebel pilot [[Ibti Myrak]] was placed on comms duty by Skywalker for her actions during the attack. While [[Rogue Squadron]] went to aid in an [[Ambush in the Valo system|ambush]] in the [[Valo system]], Myrak stayed back with Ackbar to work on comms. But when she realized that something was not right, she sprinted off as Ackbar called to her to figure out where she was going.<ref name="SWA 11" />

But Ackbar caught up to Myrak in the hangar bay and called her out for attempting to leave and thus disobeying Commander Skywalker's orders. Myrak tried to plead her case but the annoyed admiral was not having it and ordered her to report back to the flight deck. But the reckless pilot insulted the admiral and shoved the chief [[technician]] [[Garn Stewer]] into Ackbar, knocking him down. Myrak apologized but jumped into an X-wing and took off anyway.<ref name="SWA 12" />

C-3PO then attempted to alert Ackbar but he ignored the droid and asked for a report from Stewer. Stewer reported that they could not track Myrak because she was in hyperspace and Ackbar ordered him to get the admiral in contact with Skywalker. But Stewer was unable to because Rogue Squadron was in an ongoing battle in the Valo system.<ref name="SWA 12">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=12|story=Squad Goals, Part 2}}</ref>

As the battle raged on, R2 tried to make contact with Ackbar's fleet but to no avail. But after Myrak rescued Skywalker, the battle turned in the rebel's favor when the Rebel Fleet arrived, causing the Empire to retreat. Skywalker thanked Ackbar for arriving to save them, but Ackbar believed that Skywalker should thank Myrak for discovering encoded messages a [[Lyle Kullan|spy]] had been sending to the Empire for months.<ref name="SWA 12" />

===Road to Endor===
====Hoth====
Ackbar was present when [[Beilert Valance]] offered a [[datacard]] that held the plans to a [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]].<ref name="Two Sides to Every Sortie">{{StoryCite|story=Two Sides to Every Sortie|book=Empire Ascendant 1}}</ref> Although Admiral Ackbar was not present at the [[Battle of Hoth]], he did receive a call to come and assist with the evacuation. However, there was not enough time to scramble the rebel fleet. The evacuation was completed in a matter of hours,<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> but the Alliance suffered major losses.<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref>

After the battle, Ackbar implemented a new hyperspace jump schedule for the fleet: Jump coordinates would be transmitted from the ''[[Home One]]'' to all of the nearby ships in the fleet, with the coordinates then being given to other outposts and vessels. As a safeguard, Ackbar had every gunner in the fleet fire on any craft that came out of hyperspace on an incorrect reversion vector.<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> When X-wing pilots [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Wes Janson]] rendezvoused with the ''Home One'', Antilles speculated that the reason for the lateness of Luke Skywalker could be because of Ackbar having high-security rebels take extra hyperspace jumps.<ref name="Rendezvous Point">{{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref>

====Battle at Ab Dalis====
After the Rebel Alliance managed to escape the [[Battle of Ab Dalis]], Ackbar, Mothma, and the rest of the [[Eleventh Division]] grouped up with the [[Fourth Division|Fourth]] and [[Seventh Division]]s. They were rescued by the Fourth Division's [[Starlight Squadron]] and Commander Skywalker and given a new security transmission code based on the lost language of [[Trawak]].<ref name="Star Wars 15">[[Star Wars (2020) 15|''Star Wars'' (2020) 15]]</ref>

Sometime later, Ackbar and Mothma briefed on various updates since Hoth. Ackbar stated that while the fleet had been diminished, there was now time to address secondary goals. The first goal was to reestablish a supply chain, with Captain [[Amilyn Holdo]] negotiating a deal with the crime families until the [[Syndicate War]] broke out.<ref name="SW19">[[Star Wars (2020) 19|''Star Wars'' (2020) 19]]</ref> 

====Unity Day attack====
{{Quote|Congratulations on a successful mission, General Organa.|Ackbar to Organa|<ref name="SW26">[[Star Wars (2020) 26|''Star Wars'' (2020) 26]]</ref>}}
[[File:RebelCommand-2020StarWars26.png|220px|thumb|right|Ackbar congratulated Organa on a successful attack ]]
After the Alliance's successful [[Unity Day attack|attack]] during [[Empire Day]] on [[Bar'leth]], Admiral Ackbar congratulated Organa on the mission during a meeting. Organa appreciated Ackbar's willingness to risk rebel people and ships on missions that took place deep into the Empire's territory. During the meeting, Ackbar agreed with General [[Hera Syndulla]]'s point that the rebel fleet lost many of its connections while trying to reform after Hoth. He once again stated the Rebel Alliance needed to re-establish contacts with its intelligence assets in order to rebuild their supply lines. Ackbar recommended establishing a base so that the rebel ships could go through repairs. He then recommended the rebels continue their strategic attacks, making it public in order to show the galaxy that the Empire was vulnerable.<ref name="SW26" />

Sometime after, Ackbar took part in a briefing led by Captain Syndulla addressing recent potential intelligence the Rebellion had gathered.<ref name="SW27">[[Star Wars (2020) 27|''Star Wars'' (2020) 27]]</ref>

====Second Death Star revealed====
{{Quote|She undoubtedly has agents in the Alliance as well. We should--|Ackbar interrupted by Mothma|<ref name="SW28">[[Star Wars (2020) 28|''Star Wars'' (2020) 28]]</ref>}}
[[File:LukeRevealsDeathStarII-2020StarWars28.png|175px|thumb|left|Rebel command was shocked by the revelation of a second Death Star]]
Skywalker undertook a [[Mission to Coruscant|mission]] to [[Coruscant]] to rescue [[Crimson Dawn]] [[Sleeper Agent|spies]] who defected from the Empire. Upon his return, he held a briefing with rebel command on highly important intel. When asked where Organa was, Ackbar told him that she was in another sector, due to recent rebel efforts to not gather too much of the fleet at once. Skywalker's revelation that the spies were from Crimson Dawn, a worried Ackbar believed that Dawn also had spies in the Rebel Alliance. Skywalker continued and revealed the Empire was constructing a [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]], shocking rebel command.<ref name="SW28" />

Later on, Ackbar briefed Alliance members on an [[Assault on Coruscant|aerial assault]] on the Imperial [[capital]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="SW36">[[Star Wars (2020) 36|''Star Wars'' (2020) 36]]</ref>

====Chaos on the ''Home One''====
{{Quote|I can see that commander! Run diagnostics... get slicers up here to break into the systems... and get this ship back under our control!|Admiral Ackbar to a rebel commander|<ref name="SW37" />}}
The [[Scourge]], a malevolent droid, possessed [[Petyr]], a [[Crusaders|crusader]] of the [[Second Revelation]] droid freedom group. Petyr then secretly boarded the ''Home One'', and possessed C-3PO, while Ackbar and other rebel leaders discussed how to take down the second Death Star.<ref name="Dark Droids 1">[[Dark Droids 1|''Dark Droids'' 1]]</ref>

All of a sudden, the [[AJ^6 cyborg construct|cybernectic implants]] in the [[cyborg]] [[Lobot]] malfunctioned, causing the ''Home One'' to go into battle alert. The [[deflector shield|shield]] batteries were activated, confusing Ackbar as he gave no such order. Ackbar ordered all rebel personnel that the [[cruiser]] had gone into red-alert status and to report to their battle stations immediately. As chaos ensued on the ''Home One'', a [[Unidentified rebel commander|rebel commander]] reported to Admiral Ackbar that the ship was acting like it was in battle but there was no enemy detected. Ackbar ordered the commander to run diagnostics and break into the systems in order to get the ''Home One'' under control.<ref name="SW37">[[Star Wars (2020) 37|''Star Wars'' (2020) 37]]</ref>

Rebel personnel then reported the main [[turbolaser]] batteries were warming up with no activation codes. Ackbar ordered the rebel fleet to take evasive maneuvers, as the ''Home One'' began to open fire. At the same time, rebel member [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] discovered Lobot was at fault for the chaos and was forced to destroy his implants in the process. Ackbar then ordered a full investigation into who could've been responsible.<ref name="SW37" />

====Siege of Inyusu Tor====
[[File:Inyusu_Tor_Siege.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Inyusu Tor came under siege.]]
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Sullust">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' establishes that the [[Siege of Inyusu Tor]] takes place twenty-two [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Clone Wars]], which [[Mission to Mustafar|ended]] in [[19 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. The siege must have therefore occurred in [[3 ABY]].</ref> Alliance Intelligence introduced [[Operation Ringbreaker]], a series of coordinated assaults which had the goal of shutting down the naval shipyards at the [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. Once its defenses were stretched to the tipping point, naval and infantry forces would attack. General Madine sent the Phase 1 overview of Ringbreaker, which detailed how the [[61st Mobile Infantry]] would secure multiple targets.<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

The Operation was planned to culminate with the sabotage of the Kuat Drive Yards. However, the operation came to a halt at the [[Siege of Inyusu Tor]] when Imperial resistance was more than the rebel forces could handle. Ackbar said<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> in 34 ABY<ref name="Date TRF" /> that Operation Ringbreaker was brilliantly planned but was brought low by undetectable circumstances. Commander Mothma said that another attempt to take Kuat would not be attempted.<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

====Trial of Lando Calrissian====
{{Quote|By the tide...Mon Mothma's been kidnapped!|Ackbar shocked by Mothma's kidnapping|<ref name="SW44" />}}
[[File:LandoTrial-2020StarWars44.png|275px|thumb|left|Admiral Ackbar was a magistrate for Calrissian's trial.]]
Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date SW44">The events of [[Star Wars (2020)|''Star Wars'']] take place after the [[Escape from Cloud City]] and before the [[Rescue of Han Solo]], which are dated to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> Lando Calrissian stood trial in accordance with the [[Corellian code of military justice]] for [[treason]] against the Rebellion. Ackbar, along with Mothma and General Madine, served as [[magistrate]]s for the trial. Admiral Ackbar and Madine argued pre-trial that Calrissian should be executed for his crimes, but Mothma and Organa advised that it would harm rebel morale. However during the trial, Mothma who was participating via [[hologram]] was [[Kidnapping of Mon Mothma|kidnapped]] by [[Scarabi]] mercenaries, shocking Ackbar.<ref name="SW44">[[Star Wars (2020) 44|''Star Wars'' (2020) 44]]</ref>

Admiral Ackbar then activated [[Tactical Plan Eighteen]], which ordered the Alliance Fleet to disperse to random locations in the event their location had been compromised. Calrissian's [[lawyer]], [[Salli Georgio]] argued that the case must be dismissed due to Mothma being incapacitated, but Ackbar and the other magistrates disagreed, allowing for the trial to continue. Shortly after, he was present with the rest of Rebel High Command to receive a ransom from the Scarabi for 200 million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], due within a day before the mercenaries could consider third parties. Ackbar then proclaimed that the Alliance would be bankrupt if they paid.<ref name="SW45">[[Star Wars (2020) 45|''Star Wars'' (2020) 45]]</ref>

[[File:LandoVerdict-2020StarWars47.png|250px|thumb|right|Ackbar and the magistrates find Calrissian guilty.]]
Later on, Ackbar and the rebel commanders analyzed potential Scarabi safehouses brought forward by Chewbacca, in order to [[Mission to rescue Mothma|rescue]] Mothma. Unfortunately for Ackbar, he was having difficulty understanding the [[Wookiee]]'s native [[language]], [[Shyriiwook]]. Dispatching the pathfinders, the rebels were able to rescue Mothma and Calrissian's trial continued.<ref name="SW46">[[Star Wars (2020) 46|''Star Wars'' (2020) 46]]</ref> 

[[Lobot]] testified in Calrissian's defense, describing him as loyal but Ackbar argued that the trial was taking place for the opposite reason. Lobot responded to him by providing evidence of how Calrissian had been loyal to him. After more testimonies and then closing statements, the magistrates discussed for five minutes before delivering a guilty verdict. Ackbar ordered Calrissian to pay the Rebel Alliance 250 million credits in compensation for treason, but the debt was suspended pending the end of the war and could be decreased based on his contributions to the Rebellion.<ref name="SW47">[[Star Wars (2020) 47|''Star Wars'' (2020) 47]]</ref>

====Preparing to strike====
{{Quote|The Empire has begun construction on a second Death Star|Admiral Ackbar briefs rebel leaders|<ref name="Moving Target">''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Death_Star_II_revealed.png|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Ackbar solemnly reveals the second Death Star.]]
Around [[4 ABY]],<ref name="HC 53">{{HelmetCollectionCite|53|Highlights of the Saga}}</ref> many rebel leaders rendezvoused at the planet [[Zastiga]]. During a top clearance meeting, a hologram was shown of an incomplete Death Star. Many present, including Princess Leia, were confused, assuming that it was the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] from the Battle of Yavin. Ackbar then revealed that the Empire had begun construction on a second Death Star, with a larger diameter and many advanced specifications such as an advanced [[superlaser]]. The other leaders at the meeting began to discuss what the Alliance's next move would be, and how they would go about destroying it. General [[Airen Cracken]] and Ackbar explained that the flaw that had allowed the first Death Star to be destroyed at the hand of Skywalker would have been removed. He and Mon Mothma agreed that the Rebellion would have to make their attack before the [[battle station]]s completion.<ref name="Moving Target" />

[[File:Leia_on_the_Shieldmaiden.png|thumb|right|275px|Operation Yellow Moon (pictured) was a success.]]
The next day, the leaders returned to the briefing room, many of whom were exhausted. When Mothma motioned for him to begin, Ackbar once again brought up the holo of the second Death Star. He explained that the Death Star would be vulnerable as long as its [[Reactor|main reactor]] was exposed. When Admiral [[Massa]] dejectedly said that the entire rebel fleet would not be enough to defeat the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial Fleet]], Ackbar fired back, explaining that they would not be able to win the battle ship to ship, but rather by creating [[time]] for their starfighters. Ackbar also revealed that they had learned that the station was protected by an energy field generated from the surface of a nearby moon. Madine's [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|commandos]] would steal an [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|Imperial shuttle]], get to the moon, and knock out the generator.<ref name="Moving Target" />

One [[Unidentified Mon Calamari admiral|admiral]] pointed out that it would be difficult for the fleet to assemble without the Empire noticing. Ackbar explained,<ref name="Moving Target" /> as he had previously told Mon Mothma, that Sullust was the only realistic fleet staging area if the Alliance was to take advantage of the [[Sanctuary Pipeline]],<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> which was a closely guarded Imperial secret until rebel agents were able to discover it. The fleet would gather there, the commando team would go and bring down the shield, and the fleet would follow, traveling down the Sanctuary Pipeline. Princess Leia then offered a [[Operation Yellow Moon|strategy]] to distract the Empire from discovering what they were up to: Leia would lead a fake recruiting run with a supposed rendezvous point, while the real fleet gathered at Sullust. Leia's suggestion of Nien Nunb to be her pilot on the mission was supported by Ackbar. Organa assumed that since Ackbar did not object to her plan, he approved of it. Although the plan was not immediately vetoed, it did take some more consideration from Mothma.<ref name="Moving Target" />

When Madine volunteered himself for the mission, Ackbar shot this down, saying that Madine was required to stay to help plan for Endor.<ref name="Moving Target" /> Ackbar also mentioned that since the Rebellion had already struck Sullust during [[Operation Ringbreaker]], it would be believable that they would do so again. He promised Mothma that after the Battle of Endor, the fleet would return to liberate Sullust.<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> In 34 ABY,<ref name="Date TRF" /> Ackbar said that this was accomplished, but months after Endor as opposed to the planned days.<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

[[File:General_Lando.png|thumb|left|230px|Admiral Ackbar recruited Lando Calrissian (left) to lead the starfighter attack]]
During [[Commander]] [[Iden Versio]]'s [[Escape from the Invincible Faith|escape from the ''Invincible Faith'']], she snuck past a room where Ackbar was debriefing rebel personnel to join the rest of the Rebel fleet who were to join together at [[Sullust]] to launch a surprise attack on the second Death Star.<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref> When Mothma asked who Ackbar had chosen to lead the starfighter attack on the second Death Star, she suggested Luke Skywalker. Ackbar, on the recommendations of the Sullustan [[Nien Nunb]] and Ensign Deltura, suggested Lando Calrissian. In order to convince Calrissian, Ackbar first tried appealing to his honor.<ref name="The Rebel Files" /> Despite Calrissian having developed a deep belief in the rebel cause,<ref name="SW45" /> Ackbar failed to appeal to Calrissian through that approach, so he went straight to [[Currency|money]].<ref name="The Rebel Files" />

====Assassination attempt on Mothma====
{{Quote|Well, I need you-- I need you to use everything you've learned and collected to find out who is out to kill Mon Mothma. But you cannot do this alone.|Admiral Ackbar dispatches Kes Dameron and his wife|<ref name="The Rebellion 1" />}}
[[File:Ackbar-ROTJTheRebellion1.png|255px|thumb|right|Ackbar ordered Dameron to prevent Mothma's assassination attempt]]
Six [[Standard day|days]] before the [[Battle of Endor]], Admiral Ackbar received a transmission from [[Buccel Trune]] who learned of a [[Attempt to assassinate Mon Mothma|plot]] to [[assassin]]ate Mon Mothma. Skeptical at first, Ackbar questioned Trune on the legitimacy of the intelligence, but Trune reassured him the threat was very serious.<ref name="The Rebellion 1">[[Return of the Jedi – The Rebellion 1|''Return of the Jedi – The Rebellion'' 1]]</ref>

Afterwards, Ackbar met with Mothma, who was unconcerned with the plot. She believed the Rebel Alliance had to press forward with the planned attack on the second Death Star and not waste any resources on uncovering a potential false plot. But the Admiral argued the Rebellion could protect her and push forward at the same time. He believed the safety of all rebel leaders was a top priority if the Rebellion was to become a republic. Meanwhile, Mothma noted his opinion she still believed the plot to be false, with little reliable evidence to back up the intel. Ackbar believed the intel was similar to a double-edge [[sword]], in that while the finer details were scant the broad details remained true. Even though he continued to plead his case, Mothma refused to reallocate any resources to her protection and did not want to hear any protest from the Admiral.<ref name="The Rebellion 1" />

Shortly afterwards, Admiral Ackbar went behind Mothma's back and secretly met with [[Kes Dameron]] via hologram to discuss protecting the rebel leader. Dameron understood Mothma's point and questioned why Ackbar called him in the first place. Ackbar, stressed from the recent news, explained to Dameron that the Rebel Alliance was on the cusp of something big and they would need everything to go right in order to achieve success. He believed the assassination plot happened at the worst possible time for the galaxy. Admiral Ackbar then ordered Dameron, alongside his wife, [[Shara Bey]] to locate and prevent the assassination.<ref name="The Rebellion 1" />

Ackbar's suspicions and the intelligence would be proven true when the Empire did attempt to assassinate Mothma but the Rebel Alliance pathfinders were able to foil the plan.<ref name="The Rebellion 1" /> 

====Battle of Endor====
{{Quote|It's a trap!|Admiral Ackbar|audio=ItsATrap-ROTJ.flac|<ref name="Episode VI" />}}
[[File:AdmiralAck.png|thumb|220x220px|Admiral Ackbar during the Battle of Endor.]]
Ackbar was one of the commanders of the Battle of Endor. At the pre-mission briefing, Gial told the plan of how the Rebels would attack the Death Star. He explained that a ground team led by General Han Solo would go to the surface of the forest moon of [[Endor]] and take out the shield generator and that a fighter squadron led by General Lando Calrissian would then enter the battle station's superstructure and take it out from the inside.<ref name="Episode VI" /> After the briefing, Ackbar pulled aside [[engineer]] [[Evans Basch]] to apologize for being unable to find the [[refugee]], [[Tobie]]. He then told Basch that he had given the Alliance hope and that he must seize it.<ref name="Hyperspace Stories 12">[[Hyperspace Stories 12|''Hyperspace Stories'' 12]]</ref>

He commanded the fleet from the bridge of his ship, ''Home One''. Once the battle commenced, however, between the fleet's sensors being jammed and an Imperial fleet cutting off their escape, Ackbar realized that they had been led into a trap—the Empire was leading them to their demise. Ackbar was reluctant to continue the battle after the Rebels saw that the Death Star's superlaser was operational. However, Calrissian convinced him otherwise. Once Han Solo's squad took out the shield generator, Ackbar's fleet held off the rest of the Imperial forces while Calrissian and his fighters, along with [[Wedge Antilles]], flew inside the Death Star to take it out. Ackbar especially told his forces to concentrate their firepower on the ''[[Executor]]'', which was ultimately destroyed by an A-wing.<ref name="Episode VI" /> Ackbar was devastated by the loss of life that took place at the battle.<ref name="Ackbar DB" />

In the aftermath of the battle, Ackbar addressed the Alliance informing them that the time to celebrate had come and that Skywalker had reported the deaths of Palpatine and Vader. However, he warned that the time to rest had not yet arrived, saying the Empire's weapon may have been destroyed but the Empire itself lived on and stated the oppressive hands of the Empire closed around the throats of good, free-thinking people across the galaxy. He ended by saying that their fight would continue because, while the rebellion was over, the war was just beginning.<ref name="Aftermath" />

===New Republic===
====Rebellion on Akiva====
{{Quote|But we also must recognize the Empire's ability to play the long game. Our victory over Endor was fortunate, but the Empire orchestrated that trap with great patience.|Admiral Ackbar debating strategy with fellow New Republic leaders|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
[[File:Shattered_Empire_1_textless_cover.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The great victory at Endor did not mark an end to the Galactic Civil War.]]
Despite the Empire's defeat at Endor, they continued to fight, launching [[Operation: Cinder]], a contingency plan issued posthumously by the Emperor. Over three months after the Battle of Endor,<ref name="SE4">[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]]</ref> the Alliance officially reorganized into a [[New Republic]], continuing to defend against the Imperial attacks. As Admiral, Ackbar commanded the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] in its campaign against the [[Imperial holdouts|remnants of the Empire]]. In his free time, Ackbar honed his mind by practicing with his [[kar-shak]] against simulated [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="Aftermath" /> He stated in a public [[HoloNet]] address that he knew the fighting had not yet come to a close.<ref name="HC 1" />

Admiral Ackbar's military campaign against the Empire was aided by a mysterious Imperial informant known as [[Gallius Rax|the Operator]], who leaked intelligence about Imperial military movements. While Ackbar was practicing with his kar-shak, he was visited by [[Ensign]] [[Ardin Deltura|Deltura]] who informed the Admiral that Captain Wedge Antilles had ceased communicating with them after his scouting mission to [[Raydonia]]. Ackbar ordered Deltura to send scouts to five nearby planets including [[Mustafar]], [[Geonosis]], [[Dermos]], [[Akiva]], and [[Tatooine]]. As a precaution, Ackbar ordered Deltura to dispatch two scouts to Akiva.<ref name="Aftermath" />

Deltura then informed him that they had received new information from the Operator. When Ackbar expressed surprise that an Ensign was privy to classified information, Deltura reassured him that Commander [[Kyrsta Agate]] had given him clearance. Deltura dispatched two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing scout ships]] to Akiva but the ships were shot down by an Imperial Star Destroyer commanded by [[Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]]. The Empire was hosting an [[Akiva Summit|emergency summit]] on the planet and Antilles had been captured by Imperial forces there.<ref name="Aftermath" />

Following the downing of the scout ships, Admiral Ackbar corresponded with several New Republic leaders and officials via [[hologram]] including Commander Agate Captain [[Saff Melor]], General [[Crix Madine]], and the newly-appointed [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]]. When Agate suggested they could trust the Operator, Ackbar warned that the Battle of Endor showed that the Empire had the ability to play the long game. When Melor advocated sending in a fleet to Akiva, Mothma urged caution to avoid creating the impression that the New Republic were invaders.<ref name="Aftermath" />

While Melor and Mothma debated the merits of aiding a strategically marginal planet like Akiva, Ackbar sided with the Chancellor and urged his comrades to be ready for Imperial traps. He then asked General Madine whether he could send a small strike team of [[New Republic Special Forces]] soldiers to investigate Akiva. Madine replied that was possible and Ackbar agreed to send a small scouting party to Akiva. This party was attacked by Imperial [[turbolaser]]s but one member [[Sergeant]] [[Jom Barell]] survived and played a role in the subsequent [[rebellion on Akiva]]. Ackbar was informed about the attack on Barell's scouting parting by Ensign Deltura and [[Science officer]] [[Niriian]].<ref name="Aftermath" />

[[File:Captain_Wedge_Antilles.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Wedge Antilles (pictured) was able to escape Imperial custody and alert Gial Ackbar to operations on Akiva.]]
During the summit, Antilles managed to break free for a short duration and send an emergency transmission to Ackbar, explaining the dire situation. In response, Ackbar prepared a small fleet to attack the Imperial presence on Akiva. Ackbar assigned Commander Agate to lead the attack on Akiva. Agate's small fleet destroyed two Star Destroyers while the New Republic pilot [[Norra Wexley]], her son [[Temmin Wexley|Temmin]] and a small rebel cell engineered an uprising that overwhelmed the meagre Imperial garrison and the collaborationist [[Satrapy of Myrra]]. Akiva became one of the first [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] worlds to join the New Republic.<ref name="Aftermath" />

Admiral Ackbar's victory on Akiva was aided by the Operator, who sent intelligence about the position of the orbiting Star Destroyers. Despite finding his information useful, Ackbar did not fully trust the Operator,<ref name="Aftermath" /> who later turned out to be [[Fleet Admiral]] Gallius Rax.<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> A month later, Ackbar presented a medal to Norra Wexley for her service in rescuing Antilles and helping the New Republic to liberate Akiva from the Empire.<ref name="Aftermath" />

====Commanding the starfleet====
{{Quote|Grand Admiral Ackbar.''"<br />"Grand admiral'' is an Imperial ranking. I, like you once did, identify as ''fleet admiral''—but you seem to have taken the title 'Grand Admiral' for yourself.|Grand Admiral Sloane and Admiral Ackbar exchange greetings|<ref name="Life Debt" />}}
[[5 ABY|One year]] after the Alliance's victory at Endor, the now-Fleet Admiral Ackbar led the New Republic Starfleet's campaign against the remnants of the Empire. While Ackbar's work took him into space, the Admiral still visited the New Republic capital of [[Chandrila]] to consult with Chancellor Mon Mothma and other leaders. On one such trip, Admiral Ackbar met with the New Republic starfighter pilot Norra Wexley at [[Skygarden]] above [[Hanna City]]. He ordered her to cease her mission to rescue the missing Han Solo and to resume her hunt for Imperial commissions. Norra refused to comply with this order and resigned her commission in the New Republic Navy. She, her son Temmin, the [[B1-series battle droid]] [[Mister Bones]], the former Imperial [[loyalty officer]] [[Sinjir Rath Velus]], the [[Zabrak]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jas Emari]], and the New Republic soldier Jom Barell then embarked on a quest to find Solo.<ref name="Life Debt" />

During a later meeting with Chancellor Mothma and her advisers, Ackbar opined that the New Republic was not doing enough to win former Imperial systems to the New Republic. Mothma concurred and agreed to embark on a campaign to entice prospective members by giving them a place in the reconstituted [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]]. Shortly later, Princess Leia entered the room and argued with Chancellor Mothma about not enough being done to aid the enslaved Wookiees of the planet [[Kashyyyk]]. Following a brief argument, a frustrated Leia stormed out of the meeting despite Ackbar's efforts to call out to her.<ref name="Life Debt" />

Later, Admiral Ackbar commanded a [[Defense of Kuat|successful campaign]] to capture the planet Kuat and the strategically important [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. The sector governor Moff [[Pollus Maksim]] and the guild head of Kuat Drive Yards capitulated. During the battle, Ackbar's forces lost fewer ships than their Imperial opponents. The loss of Kuat dealt a serious blow to the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Life Debt" />

[[File:WoTG-RaeSloane-Stormtroopers.png|thumb|left|250px|Grand Admiral Rae Sloane]]
Following the battle, Princess Leia contacted Admiral Ackbar by hologram to congratulate him for his role in securing the New Republic's victory. Shortly later, Chancellor Mon Mothma interrupted the conversation to inform her comrades that she had received communication from the Operator, who wanted to meet with the New Republic leadership. Ackbar ordered his comm officer [[Toktar]] to open the Old Alliance frequency Zeta Zeta Nine. The guest turned out to be [[Grand Admiral]] Sloane, the public face of the Galactic Empire. Despite Sloane's claims that she was the Operator, Ackbar did not believe her.<ref name="Life Debt" />

When Sloane addressed Ackbar as Grand Admiral, the Mon Calamari responded that Grand Admiral was an Imperial ranking and accused her of seizing the title for herself. Ackbar's colleague [[Commodore]] Agate soon joined the holo-conversation and accused Sloane of deceiving them. After exchanging some barbs, the New Republic commanders and Grand Admiral Sloane settled down to business. When Sloane revealed that she was interested in initiating [[Imperial–Republic peace talks|peace talks]] with the New Republic, Ackbar curled his chin tendrils to express skepticism. Nevertheless, he acceded to Chancellor Mothma's decision to raise the matter of the peace talks with the Galactic Senate.<ref name="Life Debt" />

In reality, the peace talks were a ruse for the Empire to stage an attack on Chandrila. Rax had manipulated Grand Admiral Sloane into approaching the New Republic for peace talks as part of his plot to use the liberated prisoners from [[Ashmead's Lock]] to assassinate the New Republic leadership. For this plot, Rax had inserted each of the prisoners with an inorganic bio-chip which allowed him to transmit signals into their brains. This turned the former prisoners into unwilling assassins.<ref name="Life Debt" />

Later, Admiral Ackbar and other New Republic officials greeted the liberated prisoners from Ashmead's Lock when they arrived at Hanna City [[Spaceport]]. After Han Solo and [[Chewbacca]] managed to stage a Wookiee uprising on Kashyyyk, Admiral Ackbar traveled on his ship ''Home One'' to support Princess Leia and Captain Wedge Antilles' [[Phantom Squadron]] in their attack on the orbiting Imperial Star Destroyers. After Solo and Chewbacca hijacked the ''[[Dominion]]'' and destroyed the Star Destroyer ''[[Vitiator]]'', the third Star Destroyer ''[[Neutralizer]]'' surrendered to Admiral Ackbar. Despite the liberation of Kashyyyk, the New Republic forces soon received news of the [[Attack on Chandrila|attack]] on Chandrila.<ref name="Life Debt" />

====Prelude to Jakku====
{{Quote|None of us are ready. No one can ever be truly ready for what war brings. The best we can do is meet it with our face forward and our hearts clear. You will do that. I know you will.|Admiral Ackbar encouraging Commodore Agate|<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Jakku_view.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The planet Jakku (pictured) was set to hold the final showdown between the Galactic Empire and New Republic.]]
Following the events on Chandrila, Rax took control of the Imperial fleets and ordered them to assemble above the planet [[Jakku]] for a showdown with the New Republic.<ref name="Life Debt" /> Several months later, Temmin and Rath Velus discovered that the Empire had relocated to Jakku. They informed Chancellor Mothma and Princess Leia but the information was leaked to the press by Chancellor Mothma's rival Senator [[Tolwar Wartol]]. After Wartol publicly attacked Mothma's leadership, Admiral Ackbar reassured Chancellor Mothma that she had made the right decision to withhold the information since she had only obtained it less than a [[standard day]]. After Mon Mothma indicated she would issue a statement to the press, Admiral Ackbar added that he would send a scout ship and [[probe droid]]s to Jakku to investigate.<ref name="Empire's End" />

Admiral Ackbar dispatched Ensign Deltura on the scout ship ''[[Oculus]]'' and several probe droids to investigate. After the scouting team confirmed that most of the Imperial remnants had relocated to Jakku, Chancellor Mothma convened an emergency session of the Galactic Senate and urged the Senate to support her resolution to send military forces to the planet. However, the resolution failed by five votes. Following the vote, Admiral Ackbar visited Chancellor Mothma to inform her that the vote had failed. He remarked that this meant that the fleet would not depart for Jakku and that the Empire would remain there.<ref name="Empire's End" />

After Rath Velus managed to convince the five senators to change their votes, the New Republic was able to send its military forces to Jakku. Prior to the battle, Admiral Ackbar managed to convince Commodore Kyrsta Agate to return to her command board the [[Starhawk-class battleship|''Starhawk''-class battleship]] ''[[Concord]]''. Agate had been disfigured during the Attack on Chandrila and had been despondent. He also visited Agate aboard her flagship and praised her as one of his best and brightest officers. When Agate remarked that some of the light had gone out of her, Ackbar complimented her for recognizing the burden of war and for not giving in to anger.<ref name="Empire's End" />

When Agate expressed doubts about her ability to captain the ''Concord'', Ackbar reassured her that none of them were truly ready for what. He added that the best they could was to meet it with forward faces and clear hearts. Ackbar also recognized that the Empire was aware of their presence and added that he would be ready for a full-scale fleet battle. When Agate opined that Jakku could be a ruse, Ackbar reassured her that they would be ready. When Agate asked if they were going to win, Ackbar responded that it would be an honor to fight alongside them regardless of whether it was their final battle or the first of many to come. The two then parted company and assumed their battle positions.<ref name="Empire's End" />

====Defeating the Empire====
{{Quote|Soldiers and pilots of the New Republic! The dreadnought ''Ravager'' is down—it falls to Jakku! Beware debris and take cover!|Admiral Ackbar during the Battle of Jakku|<ref name="Empire's End" />}}
[[File:FrontLines-AckbarJakku.png|thumb|left|230px|Admiral Gial Ackbar, as he appeared at the Battle of Jakku]]
During the [[Battle of Jakku]], Admiral Ackbar commanded the New Republic fleet. Despite outnumbering the Empire, the New Republic fleet was unable to break through the Imperial defensive lines. The Imperial Star Destroyers had formed a defensive perimeter around the [[Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Ravager]]'', the Imperial flagship. During the battle, the Star Destroyers would periodically open the flank to allow the ''Ravager'' to fire its turbolasers and torpedoes at the New Republic fleet. As a result, several New Republic warships and starfighters were destroyed.<ref name="Empire's End" />

While commanding the space battle, Ackbar also liaised with General [[Tyben]], who was commanding the ground assault via hologram from Chandrila. When Tyben opined that he should be on Jakku with [[Lieutenant General]] [[Brockway]], Ackbar countered that they needed to maintain reserve forces on Chandrila and the new capital [[Nakadia]] in case Jakku turned out to be a ruse. Ackbar then witnessed the Star Destroyer ''[[Punishment]]'' break formation with the Imperial fleet and ram the Starhawk ''[[Amity]]'', destroying both ships. Realizing that Agate's ship ''Concord'' lay in the gap, Ackbar opened the channel to contact Commodore Agate.<ref name="Empire's End" />

Believing they were in danger, Admiral Ackbar ordered the Commodore and her crew to abandon the ship. Agate ordered her crew to comply but stayed behind. She realized that the ''Punishment''{{'s}} destruction had created a gap that would allow her ship to attack the ''Ravager''. As the ''Concord'' exchanged fire with the ''Ravager'', Ackbar ordered her to abandon her ship. However, Agate convinced Ackbar to send starfighters and [[CR90 corvette]]s to attack the Super Star Destroyer's exposed flank engines. Despite some arguing, Ackbar finally accepted Agate's sacrifice and prayed that the Force would be with them all.<ref name="Empire's End" />

[[File:Battle_of_Jakku.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Ravager is destroyed'']]
The ''Concord'' was crippled by the ''Ravager'' and plummeted towards Jakku's surface. However, Agate then activated her ship's powerful [[tractor beam]] and proceeded to drag the Super Star Destroyer down with her. As the two ships descended into Jakku's orbit, Ackbar grabbed the [[intercom]] and warned all New Republic soldiers and pilots that the ''Ravager'' had been downed and to take cover and beware of falling debris. While Ackbar's crew cheered behind him, the Admiral did not cheer but prayed for the Force to protect those below and to accept Agate as one of its own.<ref name="Empire's End" />

The downing of the ''Ravager'' turned the tide of the Battle of Jakku in the New Republic's favor.
