While the battle was lost, some of the Republic's most valuable commanders were rescued and redeployed to strategic fronts elsewhere in the galaxy. ====Distracting the Republic==== After Padmé Amidala discovered Senator [[Rush Clovis]] was allied to the Separatists and conspired with them to fund a new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|droid factory]] on Geonosis,{{TCW|Senate Spy}} Grievous utilized his agile fleets to attack and [[Engagement near Dorin|invade]] the planet [[Dorin]], drawing Republic forces away from Geonosis.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars Begin}} However, Republic starfighter squadrons led by Skywalker and Tano were able to rout Grievous' forces,{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}} resulting in the loss of at least 131 Separatist units.Assuming that no kills were counted more than once, this number was obtained by using simple math to total [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s and [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s kills, as mentioned in "[[Landing at Point Rain]]." Soon after, Skywalker and his Padawan arrived at Geonosis and joined Luminara Unduli, Ki-Adi-Mundi, and Obi-Wan Kenobi for the [[Second Battle of Geonosis|second invasion of the world]]. Grievous' invasion of Dorin demonstrated that, despite inconclusive reconnaissance and information, the planet Geonosis had once more become a top priority. ====Capture of Eeth Koth==== {{Quote|Your reputation precedes you, general—the reputation of a coward and a murderer.''"
"''Murderer? Is it murder to rid the galaxy of you Jedi filth?|Eeth Koth and Grievous|audio=CowardAndMurderer-GI.flac|}} Jedi Generals were occasionally put in peril while hunting for Grievous, and while on a mission to find those who had launched [[attacks on hyperspace routes]] near the Outer Rim with his [[Eeth Koth's fleet|fleet]], Jedi Master [[Eeth Koth]]'s [[Steadfast (Venator-class)|flagship]], the ''Steadfast'', was [[Capture of Eeth Koth|ambush]] near the planet [[Arda]] in the Outer Rim{{EncyclopediaCite|Ezra Bridger and Other Users of the Force}} by Grievous and boarded the vessel with a force of battle droids. Soon after, he overwhelmed his [[Eeth Koth's unit|forces]] and confronted Koth on the ship's bridge, where he revealed he had been looking forward to meeting the Jedi Master. Koth noted that Grievous' reputation, that of a murderer and coward, preceded him, Grievous disagreed and asked whether it was murder to kill the Jedi before kicking Koth back. The two began a brief but intense duel, and Koth managed to Force push Grievous into a [[viewport]], but one of the MagnaGuards shocked him from behind with an electrostaff, and he moved in for an attack from the front. Koth blocked his attack, but MagnaGuard continued to shock him, briefly falling to his knee, and Grievous rushed in for another attack. Once again, the MagnaGuard shocked him, and the Jedi Master was quickly brought to his knees, and Grievous picked up him by the neck and carried him off the ground. [[File:JediHighCouncilGrievousTransmission-GrievousIntrigue.jpg|thumb|left|270x270px|General Grievous tortures Eeth Koth in a transmission to the Jedi.]] Grievous elected not to kill the Jedi as he usually would have, but rather held him captive, took [[Eeth Koth's lightsaber|Koth's lightsaber]] as his greatest prize, and sent a message to the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]], showing himself [[Torture|torturing]] Koth and promising to kill the Jedi Master, as he knew that it would be painful to the other members of the Order. He promised he would hunt down and eliminate the remaining Jedi. His boastful message was partly intended to attract more Jedi to kill, but primarily because he liked the agony it caused. As Grievous had planned, the Jedi Council members and clone commanders who had served Koth reacted to the shift by deciding to save the Jedi Master right away. Knowing that the Jedi had set up a trap, Grievous hoped that a rescue expedition would be sent. ====Saleucami conflict==== {{Quote|The story of Obi-Wan Kenobi ends here!|Grievous engages Kenobi|}} [[File:Grievous-Intrigue-old-thumbnail.png|thumb|right|289px|Grievous engaging Kenobi in combat.]] Seemingly unbeknownst to Grievous, Eeth Koth had managed to communicate a secret message to the Council through the use of hand signals, telling them that he and Grievous were stationed in the [[Saleucami system]]. Grievous himself, however, knew that the Jedi would be mounting a rescue effort and prepared for such a strike. In response, the Council sent three of its finest Jedi, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and [[Adi Gallia]], to rescue Koth and attempt to capture Grievous. Once they arrived, Kenobi sought out and engaged Grievous in an effort to distract him, while Skywalker and Gallia snuck aboard Grievous's [[Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer|ship]] to rescue Koth. However Grievous, having earlier deduced that he was being tricked, had laid a trap for the Jedi. Nonetheless, his attempts to stop them were futile and Skywalker and Gallia were able to successfully rescue Koth. Meanwhile, Grievous had managed to gain the upper hand in his duel with Kenobi, but his Commando Droids on his ship had been overwhelmed by Skywalker and Gallia. Unfortunately, his [[Recusant-class light destroyer|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]], which had served as his flagship in the battle that had broken out, was taking heavy fire from Skywalker's trio of Star Destroyers and was nearly destroyed. Forced to withdraw from his duel and flee, the general attempted to land on the planet of [[Saleucami]] in a [[C-9979 landing craft|Trade Federation landing ship]]. However, the craft malfunctioned, and Grievous and the droids were forced to evacuate into escape pods.{{TCW|The Deserter}} However, Obi-Wan Kenobi followed Grievous to Saleucami in an attempt to capture the cyborg general. Grievous recognized that he and his squad{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-deserter-episode-gallery|text="The Deserter" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Image 1 caption}} of B1-series battle droids needed to escape before they were located, only to then see Kenobi's ''Acclamator''-class assault ship overhead. One of Grievous's battle droids reported that their escape pod's [[transmitter]] was destroyed, making it impossible to contact the fleet as Grievous had ordered. When the B1 stated that there was only one surviving escape pod, Grievous responded that they needed to reach it as fast as possible, as its transmitter could still be functional, and ordered for his units to find him a form of transportation. With Grievous using a [[reek]] for transport through the underbrush and having appropriated several [[eopie]]s to be their pack animals,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode210.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Deserter}} Grievous and his droids moved towards the escape pod in the wetlands.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-deserter-episode-gallery|text="The Deserter" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Image 10 caption}} [[File:GeneralGrievous-Homeworld.png|thumb|300px|left|General Grievous did not allow complaints from his rapidly declining battle droids.]] However, the general did not allow for his battle droids to ride on creatures for transport, draining the B1's [[power cell]]s. The droids verbally complained about their low power, to Grievous's clear annoyance, but Grievous continued their march despite being told about their situation. Eventually, a B1 brought their situation up once more, but Grievous responded by using his green lightsaber to cut down the unit. Now scared, two other B1s said they had no more complaints, and their march continued into the later hours of Saleucami's day. However, Kenobi and his forces, having performed a [[robolobotomy]] on a B1 found at the landing craft's crash site, were able to locate Grievous's initial pod. Kenobi deduced they were heading for another pod and spoke with the clone trooper [[Jesse]]. The Jedi General reported that Grievous was on the move and ordered for Jesse and his squad{{SWE|characters|jesse|Jesse}} to move towards the final pod, so that way the Republic could have all their possible firepower when confronting Grievous. Kenobi and his forces then moved to the west to catch the cyborg general. Elsewhere, Grievous was frustrated that they had not reached the pod. One of his B1s, which were now running very low on power, responded that they were nearly there, although the unit's low power caused it to mix the sentence's words into the wrong order. Another B1 was able to clarify they were only a [[kilometer]] away, but both these droids ran out of power and closed down. Grievous and his remaining droids did make it to the pod, but the incoming Republic forces had come close enough to get a visual. Grievous immediately asked a B1 if their transmitter was working, knocking the B1 to the ground after hearing the unit did not know and had yet to use it. Grievous ordered another B1, who was surprised that Grievous had reached them, to send a signal to the fleet, but this droid then told Grievous that multiple life-forms were closing in. After hearing this, Grievous ordered for the droids to take up battle positions. One B1 fired a [[missile]] directly at the All Terrain Tactical Enforcer Kenobi was riding on, but the Jedi Master was able to jump off before it was hit and charged forward with his clone soldiers. As the battle raged, Grievous questioned where his shuttle was, but his answer eventually came when a ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle flew overhead, which the general was relieved to see.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-deserter-episode-gallery|text="The Deserter" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Image 15 caption}} [[File:Saleucami_final_duel.jpg|thumb|right|295x295px|Grievous and Kenobi briefly duel on Saleucami.]] Kenobi ordered for an AT-TE to take the shuttle down, but, during its second landing attempt, a [[clone gunner]] reported that the [[mass-driver cannon]] was overheated. Kenobi ran in stop Grievous himself, but, after a B1 alerted Grievous that the Jedi was behind him, Grievous was able to block [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber|Kenobi's lightsaber]]. Engaging in a brief duel, Kenobi was able to disarm Grievous of one of his lightsabers, but the cyborg kicked Kenobi away. Climbing to the top of the escape pod, Grievous told the shuttle's B1 pilots to not land, and instead he fired an ascension cable to the bottom of the [[starship]]. The shuttle was then able to fly away from the Republic Army, leaving Kenobi crestfallen. While Kenobi told Clone Commander Cody to tell their cruisers to stop the shuttle, Grievous was ultimately able to escape and continue to serve in the war. Eeth Koth had been successfully rescued, but the disappointment of missing out on a much larger victory lingered. After Grievous escaped from his Republic pursuers on Saleucami, he saw that the world would be a good outpost. As a result, he [[Invasion of Saleucami|deployed]] a large Separatist force, which fought an enemy blockade of Saleucami, to the planet.{{EncyclopediaCite|Mustafar and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} Sometimes later, Grievous's efforts were prevented by the Republic fleet along the [[Hydian Way]], bolstered by Plo Koon.{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} ====Battle of Kamino==== {{Quote|All is ready, general.''"
"''Good. We will attack Tipoca City first.''"
"''I have the exact locations of both the clone DNA room and the clone trooper barracks.''"
"''Both shall be annihilated under my hand.''"
"''Our hands, general. Count Dooku assigned us both this task.''"
"''But of course, assassin. I look forward to meeting you.|Asajj Ventress reports to Grievous that they are ready to attack Kamino|}} [[File:GrievousVentress-KaminoARC.png|thumb|right|320x320px|Grievous and Ventress meet in person for the first time.]] Despite the failure of their first attempt, Grievous and Ventress planned to launch another [[Battle of Kamino|invasion of]] Kamino. However, a transmission between the two was intercepted by the Galactic Republic, and as a result the [[501st Legion]] was deployed to Kamino in preparation for the impending attack. As the two conferred before the battle, Grievous decided to start their initial assault on [[Tipoca City]], home of the Republic's cloning facilities. Jedi General [[Shaak Ti]] was already on Kamino, while Wullf Yularen was in charge of a Republic [[Kamino blockade|blockade]] against Grievous'[[Grievous's fleet| fleet]]. As Grievous engaged the Republic blockade, Ventress, with her [[Trident-class assault ship|''Trident''-class assault ships]] and [[AQ-series battle droid]]s, attacked the city. After the initial struggle, Grievous managed to break through the blockade and land on the surface with the remainder of his forces, desperate to deny his rival commander the opportunity to claim all the credit. Once there, he proceeded to speak with Ventress about their objectives: Grievous would assault the clone trooper barracks while Ventress would get a sample of [[Jango Fett]]'s [[DNA]], the Grand Army's [[Clone template|prime clone]]. During the assault, Ventress managed to acquire the DNA sample, but her escape was prevented by Skywalker, and in the ensuing fight the sample was lost. Elsewhere, Grievous was confronted by Kenobi and the two engaged in a heated battle until a ''Trident'' ship destroyed the pier they were fighting on. Grievous, thinking Kenobi had been killed in the explosion, made his escape aboard a flight pod. He then rescued Ventress from Skywalker and the clones. Both Separatist commanders failed in their tasks and were forced to flee. As the war continued, clone production resumed, and the Separatists faced a growing number of clones. Nonetheless, Grievous' attack demonstrates two things: any planet in the Republic was vulnerable, and the Republic has intelligence leaks. ===Continuing the war=== ====Obstructing peace==== {{Quote|There is a problematic situation brewing in the Senate. We must ensure that everything my master has set in motion does not unhinge. My representatives in the Republic are relying on you, general. See that your droids complete their mission.''"
"''But of course, Count. They will not fail.|Count Dooku orders Grievous to bomb the power generator on Coruscant|{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}}} [[File:CoruscantPowerGeneratorDestroyed-HOBS.png|thumb|left|263x263px|Coruscant's central power distribution grid is successfully bombed.]] Dooku, at the behest of his master, ordered Grievous to arrange an [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid|attack]] on Coruscant. Grievous turned to his [[engineer]]s and oversaw their efforts to create a new model of [[demolition droid]], which they chose to design in such a manner that the droids could disguise themselves as a regularly seen model of [[Cleaning droid|sweeping droid]].{{BuildR2Cite|77|Droid Directory}} Dooku's impetus was to thwart the [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative|peace initiative]] and the efforts of peace-minded [[senator]]s in both the Republic [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] and Separatist [[Separatist Senate|Parliament]], as well as to ensure the warmongering [[Republic financial reform bill]] that would deregulate the InterGalactic Banking Clan, which both sides relied on. He sent the six [[infiltrator demolition droid]]s, disguised as cleaning droids, to Corsucant and successfully destroyed a critical [[central power distribution grid]]. As the Senate debated the deregulation of the Banking Clan, the droids infiltrated and destroyed a critical [[power generator]] hub, plunging a section of the [[ecumenopolis]] into chaotic darkness. The immediate fear that resulted pushed the bills of banking deregulation into law. Coruscant suffered more damage from the droids than from any other attack in 1000 years, with many more explosions and many more casualties. Following their success on Felucia, the Separatists begin construction several outposts on the planet, planning to maintain a droid presence there. The Republic's war effort was affected by their victory, and it would take weeks for them to regain any type of initiative. Plo Koon, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano led the 104th Battalion into enemy territory, with the help of clone tank divisions, seeking to shatter the Separatists' control on Felucia. Grievous learned that Republic forces led by Koon, Skywalker, and Tano [[Second Battle of Felucia|fought]] to reclaim the planet from the Separatists. In retaliation, Grievous supplied one of his [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)|outposts]] overseen by the tactical droid [[TZ-33]] on the planet with reinforcements to secure the [[Felucia system|system]]. The Separatist base was quickly taken over by the Republic, taking control of Felucia and the surrounding region but the battle would not end here.{{TCW|Padawan Lost}} After [[King of Mon Cala|King]] [[Yos Kolina]] of the [[Mon Calamari]],{{TCW|Water War}} who had sought assistance from the Republic and the Jedi against the Separatists, was found murdered, the Republic dispatched Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and Senator Padmé Amidala to try to ease tensions. By then, Grievous' fleets had taken over much of the surrounding space. The Separatists, for their part, sent the bloodthirsty [[Karkarodon]] warlord [[Riff Tamson]] to represent their interests, unaware that he was responsible for Kolina's death. Following this, a [[Battle of Mon Cala|civil war]] between the [[Quarren]] and Mon Calamari broke out on the planet, which was eventually ended by the actions of Yos Kolina's successor, [[Prince]] [[Lee-Char]]. ====Skirmish on Naboo==== {{Quote|This turn of events is unfortunate. General Grievous is a critical part of my plan for the Clone Wars. He must not remain captive.''"
"''What is to be done, my lord?''"
"''You mkust lure Skywalker into a trap, then negotiate a prisoner exchange.''"
"''How can you be certain the Republic will trade for Skywalker?''"
"''I have no doubt Senator Amidala will gladly to your terms.''"
As you wish, my lord.|Darth Sidious to Count Dooku in order to free Grievous|{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}}} [[File:GrievousonNaboo.png|thumb|right|270x270px|Grievous discusses his plans for Naboo with Jar Jar Binks, posing as Boss Lyonie.]] Later during the Clone Wars, Grievous suffered a defeat when he attempted to [[Skirmish on Naboo|invade]] Naboo. The Trade Federation had already tried to conquer the planet during the [[Battle of Naboo|invasion]] a [[32 BBY|decade]] earlier,{{Film|I}} and the Separatists now sought to seize Naboo once again. This time, the scheme was directed by Dooku and carried out by Grievous.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars}} Naboo had long been a prize for Dooku, in part because of its connections to Chancellor Palpatine, who had once served as the planet's senator before rising to become the leader of the Republic, and secretly the Sith Lord Darth Sidious.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Heroes of Naboo and Other Characters of the Galaxy}} Grievous had taken considerable pleasure in Dooku's earlier humiliation when the count was captured and imprisoned by the infamous [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang|his crew]]. Now, however, Grievous would receive a lesson in arrogance of his own. Although Grievous welcomed the opportunity to wage war on Naboo, he did not believe the [[Gungan]]s would make useful allies. Dooku, meanwhile, was on Naboo to ensure that the general followed his orders. Dooku and his [[agent]], [[Minister]] [[Rish Loo]], managed to seize control of the Gungan [[Boss]] [[Lyonie]], as well as the [[Gungan Grand Army]]. The Gungan Army would not march on [[Theed]], but Grievous and his army arrived on Naboo aboard C-9979 landing craft, demanding to speak to Lyonie about why the Gungans had withdrawn their support. Naboo's representative, [[Jar Jar Binks]], posing as Boss Lyonie, and Gungan General [[Roos Tarpals]] were sent to distract him from launching his attack. Binks, accompanied by General Tarpals, entered the Trade Federation landing ship and negotiated with the Separatist leader. Binks was horrified to learn that it was Grievous. Enraged and impatient, Grievous yelled at the disguised Gungan, incensed by Boss Lyonie's unexpected change of plans. Grievous planned to assault Naboo with or without the assistance of the Gungan Grand Army. Tarpals received secret instructions from Jar Jar to ready his troops to repel the droid army. Tarpals left the meeting and contacted Senator Amidala, notifying her of Grievous's presence on Naboo and that Anakin was pursuing Rish Loo. He was then ordered to find a way to capture Grievous without his knowledge. Grievous, however, caught wind of the plan and quickly deduced that Lyonie was an impostor before leaving his shuttle. [[File:GrievousVsGungans-SW.png|thumb|left|270x270px|Grievous engaged the Gungans.]] As Grievous pursued Binks, he was confronted by the Gungan forces and found himself alone and surrounded by the [[militiagung]]s. The Gungan general offered Grievous the opportunity to surrender, but he refused, drawing two lightsabers and provoking the [[amphibian]]s to fight. He found the situation amusing, believing that no number of Gungans could possibly match him, and foolishly insulted the warriors surrounding him, who were clearly afraid of him. Grievous managed to deflect several [[booma]]s and killed several militiagungs one by one as they rushed to attack him. Although his men had successfully deactivated the droid forces, Grievous proved more difficult to deal with and remained a serious threat. Tarpals fearlessly walked out to face Grievous alone. Knowing that he had little hope against the Separatist general, Tarpals intervened and engaged him in a duel, disarming Grievous of his blue-bladed lightsaber. Tarpals then sacrificed himself, allowing Grievous to run him through so that he could get close enough to use his [[electropole]]. After being impaled, Tarpals drove the electropole into Grievous' droid-like body at close range, stunning the cyborg. The attack temporarily disrupted all of Grievous' electrical systems, allowing the nearby warriors to quickly seize him. The Gungan Army then bombarded the injured general with a barrage of boomas, disabling and knocking him down and leaving him stunned. The Gungans successfully captured Grievous and took him prisoner. In a [[Rish Loo's laboratory|secret headquarters]] hidden inside the ancient ruins of Naboo, Dooku was ordered by Darth Sidious to find a way to release Grievous, since the cyborg warrior was an important part of his master plan for the Clone Wars. Sidious was confident that Senator Amidala would agree to release Grievous under these conditions. Just as Anakin arrived in the chamber, Dooku abruptly stabbed Rish Loo with his lightsaber, but Anakin had no idea that he had been lured into a trap to be captured. Fortunately, and humiliatingly, Dooku and his MagnaGuards quickly captured Skywalker and organized a prisoner exchange, forcing Amidala to trade the imprisoned Skywalker for the cyborg. An hour later, a shackled Grievous was exchanged for an unconscious Anakin as the two prisoners crossed paths. However, for Grievous, a chance soon presented itself, demonstrating that his usefulness was far from over. ====Capturing and losing Adi Gallia==== {{Quote|General, we've come across what appears to be a pirate ship.''"
"''Use that ship for target practice. Open fire!''"
"''All forward cannons, open fire!|General Grievous orders the destruction of the ''Marauder''|{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}}} [[File:GalliaVsGrievous-ND.jpg|thumb|right|263x263px|Grievous duels and defeats Gallia.]] While at the head of a small fleet, two ''Munificent''-class frigates he commanded from a Providence, Grievous launched a surprise{{HelmetCollectionCite|33|Helmets}} [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna|attack]] on the [[Adi Gallia's flagship|flagship]] of Jedi Council member Adi Gallia, who was heading back to Coruscant{{EncyclopediaCite|Ahsoka Tano and Other Users of the Force}} from a [[Mission to Aleen|mercy mission]] on [[Aleen]]. With the combined power of his three warships trumping that of Gallia's single Republic Star Destroyer, Grievous and his forces quickly boarded the damaged ship and engaged the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps|91st Recon Corps]]. Grievous dueled Gallia and gained the upper hand with a hard kick to her torso, sending her flying back as his droid forces advanced and continued fighting her while the rest of the 91st Corps evacuated the cruiser. Gallia was separated from Commander [[Neyo]] and the rest of her men long enough for Grievous to best Gallia and take her captive after a brief but intense duel with the Council member. Grievous brought her back to his dreadnought as his prisoner, and the three Separatist starships, far outmatching the single Republic cruiser, pressed fire on the ship, resulting in its explosive destruction. This behavior caused Jedi Master Plo Koon to quickly dispatch a group of Republic ships and launch a [[Rescue of Adi Gallia|rescue mission]]. Sometime later, the general attacked and destroyed a [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)|nearby pirate ship]] for target practice. However, Grievous's ship was then boarded by Plo Koon and his forces, who emerged from hyperspace with no less than five Venators, rescued Gallia, and forced Grievous to flee. ====The secrets of Ledeve==== {{Quote|You seek to destroy a power you don't comprehend."''
"''You have carved away your own connection to it. Replaced it with parts whose strength you believe you understand."''
"''But your understanding is not strength."''
''"It is small."''
''"You are small. That is all you will ever be.|Voices heard by Grievous in the Ledeve Jedi Temple|}} [[File:GrievousAboutToStrike-AORGrievous1.png|thumb|left|300x330px|Grievous confronts the Jedi Padawan atop their T-6 shuttle.]] About two years after''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' the Jedi had infiltrated his lair,{{Marvel|url=articles/comics/uncover-secrets-of-the-force-with-general-grievous|text=Uncover Secrets of the Force with 'General Grievous'}} Grievous hunted two Jedi on [[Ledeve]][[Age of Republic - General Grievous 1|''Age of Republic - General Grievous'' 1]] in the [[Expansion Region]].{{GalaxyMapPoster}} He killed a [[Unidentified Mikkian Jedi|Mikkian Jedi]] in the [[forest]], collecting her lightsaber from her body, and tracked down [[Unidentified Jedi Padawan (Grievous)|her Padawan]], waiting for him atop his [[T-6 shuttle]]. Grievous ignited all four blades and leaped at the apprentice, killing him. He obtained the boy's lightsaber, as well as a [[datapad]] revealing the location of the [[Jedi Temple (Ledeve)|Jedi Temple]], one of the Order's hidden temples he discovered. Pleased with his find, Grievous set out through the jungle to find the ancient structure, and this was repaying them for breaking into his home by entering theirs. Grievous scaled the temple and entered it, discovering a hallway of Jedi statues. Reminded of his own statues on Vassek, believing those to have been earned where the Jedi were not, Grievous reduced the statues to rubble before moving on. He evaded several traps set within the temple, climbing the ceiling to avoid a pit of lava and dodging spikes. He scrambled under other booby traps and eventually came to the central chamber. Believing the temple's secrets to be his, Grievous reached into a waterfall in an effort to obtain a shining sigil from within, but was unable to grasp it. Blaming a sensor error, Grievous kept trying to grab the image until he grew angry enough to fling himself into the raging water. [[File:GrievousFloatingInTemple-AORGrievous1.png|thumb|right|220x220px|General Grievous floating in the cosmic landscape as the voices begin to talk to him.]] The general found himself floating in a strange, cosmic landscape, and was addressed by ephemeral voices that mocked his quest for knowledge and his own cybernetic upgrades. Grievous then was made to appear as he once was, in his original Kaleesh body, as the voices accused him of seeking to destroy a power he did not understand. Glimpsing a vision of his past self, Grievous felt his limbs detaching from his body, watching in shock as he was unmade, and was left as little more than a collection of bodily organs floating in the void, the voices still mocking him for being "small." Grievous emerged from the waterfall unscathed, and attacked the flow with his blades, but was unable to cause any damage to the shining entity within. Disgusted, Grievous left the temple and sent its coordinates to a ''Providence''-class Dreadnought in orbit. He ordered the ship to fire, and the ensuing laser strike [[Destruction of the Ledeve Jedi Temple|obliterated]] the entire temple, leaving only a smoldering crater that Grievous observed until nightfall. Secure in the belief that he had burned the entity he encountered, Grievous departed—missing the sight of a glowing sigil amidst the devastation. ====Massacre on Dathomir==== {{Quote|Surprised?''"
"''Hardly. ''You're'' the one I was sent here for.''"
"''Then fight me alone. Prove you're the greater warrior. If I win, your army leaves. If ''you'' win, the Nightsisters will surrender to you.''"
"''I have ''always'' been greater than you!|Asajj Ventress and General Grievous|{{TCW|Massacre}}}} After the [[Mission to Serenno (Nightsisters)|failed assassination]] attempt on his life by his former apprentice Asajj Ventress, who had been aided by [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]] and the [[Nightsisters]] from [[Dathomir]], Dooku summoned Grievous. Dooku ordered him to [[Battle of Dathomir|attack]] Dathomir and wipe the Nightsisters out. Grievous had waited a long time to overcome his former rival, and now that opportunity had made him very pleased. [[File:DookuThroneRoom-Massacre.png|thumb|left|287x287px|Dooku orders Grievous to attack Dathomir.]] Grievous then took a Separatist fleet consisting of four ''Munificent''-class star frigates, two ''Recusant''-class light destroyers, two [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel|Separatist supply ships]], and his personal ''Providence''-class Dreadnought. Emerging from hyperspace in the [[Dathomir system]], the fleet descended upon the planet. Knowing that the Nightsisters would be formidable opponents, Grievous was determined to defeat them. He had his [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|''Hyena''-class Droid Bombers]] launch an airstrike on their [[city|village]], before beginning to land their C-9979 landing crafts to send in his ground troops to attack them. As the invasion on Dathomir started, former Sith assassin Asajj Ventress, who had returned to the planet to rejoin her clan, sensed Grievous' arrival. Despite being severely outnumbered and outgunned, the Nightsisters were initially able to hold their ground. This prompted Grievous to deploy several of his Armored Assault Tanks, which escorted a lone [[Defoliator Deployment Tank]] in order to burn the forest, which successfully managed to drive the Nightsisters back. This may had appeared to be overkill, but, for Grievous, it merely ensured that his enemies had no fighting chance. Unfortunately, Talzin had sought the assistance of [[Daka|Old Daka]], the eldest of the Nightsisters, who used her [[Magick]] to raise the [[Army of the Dead]] as reinforcements. With Ventress leading the charge, the Nightsisters pushed forward, destroying the Defoliator Tanks and fighting their way to the open field from where Grievous was commanding his troops. Both armies halted their positions opposite one another. [[File:GrievousVsVentress-Massacre.jpg|thumb|right|291px|Grievous fights Asajj Ventress on Dathomir.]] Ventress then challenged Grievous to a duel, proposing that if he won then Nightsisters would surrender to him, but if she won then Grievous and his army would leave Dathomir. The two then engaged in a fierce [[lightsaber duel]] and initially seemed equally matched, until Ventress severed Grievous's lower mechanical right arm and knocked him to the ground. Holding all the cards militarily, with no intention of honoring the result of the duel, and no longer entertained by the sport of it, Grievous ordered his battle droids to kill her. Ventress tried to fight them off, but was shot in her shoulder. As Grievous attempted to finish her off, a large wave of Nightsister [[zombie]]s attacked him, with both armies once again engaging each other in combat. With the assistance of one of her [[Luce|fellow Nightsisters]], Ventress was able to escape in the ensuing chaos. [[File:DeathOldDaka.jpg|thumb|left|260x260px|Grievous slays Old Daka.]] Whilst cutting down the attacking zombies, Grievous was contacted by Dooku, who was being magically attacked in a way similar to [[voodoo]] by Mother Talzin. Dooku ordered Grievous to follow the Nightsister magic to its source and kill Talzin before she could torture him to death. Grievous followed the [[Magical ichor|green magic trail]] to the Nightsister village and a [[Hidden Cave|secret cave]] where both Talzin and Daka were performing their magic rituals, killing several Nightsisters on the way. Grievous then ordered one of his commando droids to create an entrance to the [[cave]], where he coldly executed a [[Unidentified Nightsister (Dathomir)/Canon|Nightsister guard]] and violently murdered Daka and prevented Talzin from further torturing Dooku. When Grievous approached her, she vanished before he could kill her too and then knocked over her [[ichor cauldron]]. With Daka's death, all the arisen Nightsisters returned to the grave, leaving the rest outnumbered, overwhelmed and eventually massacred by Grievous's army. This marked the end of opposition to the massacre, leaving their rule of Dathomir little more than a relic.{{Databank|dathomir|Dathomir}} Though the Nightsisters fought bravely{{StoryCite|story=Bug (short story)|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}} and furiously against the droids, even summoning an army of the dead proved insufficient to withstand the attack or hold them back. The battle was over, and the Separatists had won, and more [[witch]]es than droids had fallen during the battle, with no one remaining to [[nurse]] the dead. Unbeknownst to them, however, Ventress and Talzin had managed to survive the battle. Faced with defeat, Ventress fled alone once more, believing she was the sole remaining Nightsister, and found her way off Dathomir.{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}} Talzin, whom Grievous reported dead, was forced to dissolve her physical form,{{Databank|dathomir|Dathomir}} {{C|History gallery, image caption 11}} vanishing into the Force to seek sanctuary in the [[Spirit world|spiritual realm]]. ====Hunting the Nightsisters==== {{Quote|Run!"
"Wipe them out. All of them."
"Run!|Grievous|{{TOTE|The Path of Fear}}}} [[File:ThePathofFear.png|thumb|right|260px|Grievous ambushes Morgan Elsbeth and her clan.]] Around that time, a small group of Nightsisters fled for their lives after an overwhelming assault from a wave of battle droids that swept through the burning forest. Grievous approached from behind and impaled one Nightsister with his lightsaber. [[Morgan Elsbeth]] and her clan ready their [[Nightsister energy bow|energy bows]] at him, and several commando droids started fire on them. He then attempted to attack Morgan. However, her mother, [[Selena]], intervened and ordered her daughter to stay back and engaged Grievous with two [[sickle]]s enchanted with magick, forcing him to activate another lightsaber. Grievous followed Selena further into the forest, away from the site of the battle, and exchanged blows with her until she hooked Grievous's blades beneath her sickles, but he released them and unleashed a powerful strike against her weapons, breaking her defense and pushing her back. Grievous advanced, spinning two lightsabers toward Selena, as Morgan had her own battle, fighting one of the command droids, leaving her defenseless and forcing her to withdraw into the woods. Grievous switched between the two lightsabers, spinning one in front of him and the other behind him, striking the older Nightsister repeatedly, then struck her sickle from below, once more breaking her defense and leaving her vulnerable. The cyborg general grabbed Selena with his foot, pinned her to the ground, threw her, and slowly approached her. He prepared to strike her down, but she rose to her feet and blocked his attack. The two engaged in a bladelock, and as Morgan turned to help her mother, Grievous activated a third blade from his left arm, stabbing Selena in the torso. In her final moments, Selena ordered her daughter to run. Grievous laughed, then struck Selena down with his three lightsabers. After striking down Selena and mockingly yelling at Morgan to run, Grievous ordered his forces to annihilate the remaining Nightsisters, leaving the landscape a burning wasteland. To root out any surviving Nightsisters, Grievous deployed patrols of [[HMP droid gunship]]s, [[Ringneck recon droid]]s and battle droids across the forests and [[Mountain Clan village|mountains]] following the battle to hunt down anyone that might have survived the Separatist invasion. Sometime after the battle, Dooku told Grievous that with the Nightsisters dead, there was no one to control the rogue [[Savage Opress]], whose powers he felt growing, to which Grievous simply mocked Dooku's notion that Opress could pose a threat to them. However, Dooku warned him that Opress was a threat to everyone, even the Jedi, and that [[Maul|something sinister]] was emerging.{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}} ====Battle with Kenobi and Invasion of Florrum==== {{Quote|Hondo.''"
"''General Grievous, I presume? What a surprise. Have a seat. What, may I ask, is the honor?''"
"''You can dispense with the pleasantries, pirate. This planet is now under Separatist control!''"
"''Ah ha... and, what do you suppose that means?''"
"''It means you have a new master, pirate scum.|General Grievous and Hondo Ohnaka|{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}}} Despite Grievous's arrogance and overconfidence led to his capture by Gungan and Republic forces on Naboo, forcing Dooku to rescue him. All was forgiven when Grievous later saved Dooku's life during the assault on the Dathomirian Nightsisters. With the Nightsisters no longer a threat and Ventress in hiding, Dooku once again used Grievous to settle a personal score. Grievous was dispatched to [[Florrum]] to destroy Hondo Ohnaka's pirate [[Hondo's complex|base]] after he humiliated Dooku and [[Mission to Florrum|held him captive]].{{TCW|Dooku Captured}} In deep space, Grievous led the Separatist fleet, organizing HMP gunships and Hyena-class droid bombers into strike groups before launching{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}} an [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet|all-out attack]].{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic, Rebel, and Resistance Starfighters}} During Grievous's ambush, the Republic forces were quickly defeated, and he became intent on capturing or killing his arch-rival.{{BuildR2Cite|45|Droid Directory}} The gunships deployed B1 and B2 battle droids, while Grievous followed behind in his ''Sheathipede''-class shuttle. He then boarded Kenobi's command ship without losing a single capital ship. There, Grievous tore through the clone trooper ranks until he reached Kenobi. After grabbing one of the clones and pinning him to the ground, he crushed the clone's neck beneath his foot before confronting Kenobi. The two proceeded to duel, with Grievous overpowering the Jedi and kicking him back against a Republic gunship as clone troopers and droids battled around them. However, Kenobi managed to escape and abandon his ship, but not before rigging it to [[self-destruct mechanism|self-destruct]]. This forced Grievous to retreat and deprived him of the useful information stored in the ship's memory banks. With Kenobi overwhelmed and the Republic forces defeated, the entire system was now under Separatist control. [[File:GrievousOnFlorrum.png|thumb|left|255x255px|Grievous and two IG-100 MagnaGuards on Florrum.]] Sometime later, Grievous and several droid transports [[Invasion of Florrum|landed]] on Florrum. Battle droids were unloaded in rows, unfurling from their racks and beginning their march, followed by commando droids and super battle droids. Grievous stalked out of his ship, hands clasped behind his back, and watched them parade before him.{{StoryCite|story=Almost a Jedi|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}} Grievous and his droid army entered the room where the pirates were feasting, and Hondo was unpleasantly surprised by the visit. Grievous informed Hondo that Florrum was now under Separatist control and had a new master, then displayed a hologram of Dooku, who questioned whether Hondo remembered their last in-person encounter, when he had been Dooku’s prisoner and attempted to sell him to the highest bidder. When Ohnaka opposed this, he was swiftly imprisoned. The Jedi and pirates soon rescued the rest of Hondo's men, fought their way through the droid forces, and fled the outpost, although one droid managed to warn the General of their presence. Grievous then decided to cut the problem short and spoke with his tactical droid before ordering his tanks to level the prison section. However, Hondo's group managed to break out and flee the base in their remaining vehicles, forcing Grievous to board his [[Grievous's Combat speeder|combat speeder]], while several [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform|STAPs]] gave chase. While Grievous and several droids continued pursuing Ahsoka and the other [[Unidentified Clan (The Gathering)|Jedi younglings]], unbeknownst to him, Hondo, his pirates, and [[Katooni]] had separated from their group and reached a [[Hondo's secret ship vault|hidden hangar]] where Hondo's secret ships were stored. Grievous exchanged several blows with Ahsoka, then boarded the [[WLO-5 speeder tank|speeder tank]] and resumed his duel with her. [[Huyang]] ordered R2-D2 to perform several risky maneuvers in an attempt to shake him off, but the tank crashed instead. Grievous reappeared, crawling on all fours and ready to continue the fight as the younglings gathered behind Ahsoka, igniting their lightsabers, unafraid and ready to battle. Grievous moved in for the kill, but Ohnaka arrived on the scene in a refurbished ''[[Slave I]]'' to pick up Ahsoka and the younglings. Ahsoka sent them to the ship and engaged Grievous in combat to cover their escape. They charged at each other, with Grievous whirling two blades in blurred circles while Ahsoka backflipped, slashed, and used the Force to gain an advantage and drive him back. However, Grievous stabbed all four of his lightsabers into the ground and skidded backward, slowing himself. He launched himself at her, but she flipped through the air. Though she proved to be a much more formidable opponent than during their previous encounter, Grievous was still more than a match for her. Two opponents repeatedly clashed with their lightsabers until Grievous grabbed Ahsoka with his clawed feet and hurled her into the air, smashing her down as he charged after her, his blades spinning rapidly. She continued rolling to evade him before leaping back to her feet, their blades meeting once again. Exhausted,{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/a-necessary-bond-episode-gallery|text="A Necessary Bond" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Image caption 18}} Ahsoka shoved Grievous with enough force to knock him back, then jumped over him and fled, leaping aboard the ship. She barely managed to escape aboard the ship on her own. Hondo then opened fire on Grievous, but a squad of Armored Assault Tanks arrived and forced them to withdraw for good, leaving an angered Grievous behind to laugh in victory. Grievous's assault on Ohnaka's base on Florrum nearly destroyed the pirate's power, avenging Dooku's earlier humiliation of Hondo. Grievous cared little about the personal grudge, he simply enjoyed crushing a weaker foe. The pirates retreated for a while, but as the Separatists lost interest and left, Hondo and his gang returned to seize a planet that was practically useless to anyone else. ====Secret transmission==== [[File:JediClonesMeeting-SW.png|thumb|right|254x254px|Grievous's transmission to other Separatist forces was located by the Republic, but they were unable to understand it due to the new encryption.]] Sometime later, Grievous sent an encoded transmission to other members of the Confederacy, but the transmission was also intercepted by the Jedi Council. However, Republic Intelligence was unable to break the new encryption technology used in the transmission, and the Republic feared this was leading to an upcoming major attack. In order to understand the transmission the Republic sent [[D-Squad]], a group of Republic droids, to a [[Aut-O's flagship|Separatist dreadnought]] to [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module|retrieve]] an [[encryption module]].{{TCW|Secret Weapons}} ===Crystal conspiracy=== ====Attempting to obtain the giant kyber crystal==== {{Quote|They won't have a problem getting it back from the Jedi? Do you think I'm an idiot? My guards just reported back to me that the crystal is in possession of Skywalker and Kenobi. [...] If you don't have the crystal then there's no reason to deal with you! Deal's off! ''[Grievous kills Edente and throws his body aside]'' I will handle this myself.|General Grievous to Edente as the Sugi panicked for his life before being killed|{{TCW|Crystal Crisis}}}} Near the end of the war, a large [[Kyber crystal]] was discovered. [[Torul Blom]], the [[Governor]] of [[Pau City]], began negotiations with Count Dooku. With the help of [[Sugi]] weapons dealers, he intended to sell the crystal to Dooku.{{BuildFalconCite|30|Guide to the Galaxy}} Grievous was sent by Dooku to acquire the massive kyber crystal from the Sugi arms dealers led by [[Endente]]. The deal was to take place on{{TCW|In Search of the Crystal}} the neutral planet of [[Utapau]], with local [[Amani]] being used as bodyguards. At least two MagnaGuards were present during the early stages of the event,{{TCW|A Death on Utapau}} while more MagnaGuards, as well as other droids, arrived later with Grievous. The Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi learned of the arms deal when they came to Utapau to [[Mission to Utapau|investigate]] the mysterious death of Jedi Master [[Tu-Anh]]. They tracked down the crystal and stole it from Endente and his [[Endente's arms dealing group|group of arms dealers]], who were trafficking it. Endente then contacted Dooku and requested that the meeting location be changed, claiming that the Amani could no longer be trusted. He arranged for Blom to meet Grievous at the city's [[spaceport]]. Upon arriving Grievous questioned Endente's whereabouts with the kyber crystal and why they are making the deal on the port instead of the plains, which Blom explained it was Endente's idea. Annoyed Grievous sent two MagnaGuards to find Endente. Upon Endente arriving in Blom's office, Grievous was reassured that the kyber crystal was on its way when the Sugi returned empty-handed to his office, but he was well aware that the kyber crystal was in the Jedi's hands and had ordered two of his MagnaGuards to scout the area. Without hesitation, he killed Endente after informing him that he was no longer useful to him, and then started off in search of the two Jedi and the crystal, accompanied by several MagnaGuards. A chase was engaged in the caves of Utapau. Two MagnaGuards opened fire on the Jedi, then fought one of them while the other leaped on top of the [[combat speeder]] carrying the crystal. Eventually, the cyborg general's speeder crashed with a horde of [[varactyl]]s, allowing Anakin and Obi-Wan to flee to Pau City. Soon after, Grievous recovered and furiously moved one varactyl out of the way, but then Governor Blom contacted him, informing him that the two Jedi had been captured again, and the crystal was therefore placed into a separatist shuttle. The cyborg arrived in time, however, Anakin and Obi-Wan had escaped, once again. Grievous stabbed Blom with a lightsaber just as he was about to apologize, mocking his apologies and acknowledgement of error{{TCW|The Big Bang}} They, however, continued their mission, following the crystal to the space above Utapau. ====Battle over Utapau==== {{Quote|You have good news for me, I hope?''"
"''Yes, my Lord. I have the kyber crystal.''"
"''Excellent. And the Jedi?''"
"''Kenobi is my prisoner.''"
"''What about Skywalker?''"
"''Skywalker is still at large. There is nowhere for him to run. He will not stay hidden for long.''"
"''Make sure that is the case, general.|Dooku and Grievous|}} [[File:Grievous_defeats_Kenobi.png|thumb|left|288px|Obi-Wan Kenobi is defeated by General Grievous.]] The pair of Jedi chased the ship carrying the crystal, but the pair themselves were being chased by Grievous in his fighter and several droid fighters. The crystal was brought to a Separatist supply ship, which the pair crashed [[Unidentified freighter (Utapau)|their ship]] into the [[hyperdrive]] of. Choosing to do a "[[number five special]]," they abandoned their [[freighter]] in escape pods, but boarded the supply ship in different [[hangar]]s. While Skywalker did not encounter resistance, only seeing one unarmed [[OOM pilot battle droid]] which he scared off, Kenobi was forced to deal with the crystal's droid escort. After Kenobi cut down several battle droids, Grievous and two vulture droids entered the hangar. Kenobi demanded that his nemesis surrender, and the two engaged in a brief duel, with Grievous quickly overpowering Kenobi, resulting in Obi-Wan's capture. While Grievous prepared an execution chamber for Kenobi, battle droids secured the crystal, with it eventually being taken to the ship's vault. Skywalker was able to eventually free Kenobi and the pair eventually reclaimed the crystal. The pair learned that the crystal could fire back energy, such as [[laser]] fire, which they used to fight their way to the hangar. When they had secured a ship, Obi-Wan made several AATs fire at the crystal, causing it to overload. While the crystal's explosion destroyed the ship, Grievous chased after the Jedi in his fighter. The pair ultimately escaped into hyperspace while the explosion grew, destroying the Separatist fleet above the planet, and Grievous was flung into space in his starfighter. With the destruction of the massive kyber crystal, he had once again failed to fulfill the tasks assigned by his ruthless superior. Soon after, Grievous [[Battle of Haruun Kal|fought]] Jedi General [[Depa Billaba]] on [[Haruun Kal]]. There, his troops decimated ninety percent of her [[Depa Billaba's battalion|clone forces]] while he personally engaged the Jedi Master in a duel,[[Kanan 9|''Kanan'' 9]] viciously defeating her and leaving her severely injured and [[coma]]tose.[[Kanan 7|''Kanan'' 7]] However, Grievous failed to confirm her death.[[Kanan 11|''Kanan'' 11]] ===Protecting Dooku=== {{Quote|The betrayer Ventress is here. Meet me on the overlook.''"
"''Yes, Master! Let's move!''"
[Vos disarms Grievous of his lightsabers]
"''You won't be needing these.''"
[Vos disarms Grievous of his comlink]
"''Sorry. Need this, too. Can't have you contacting the count, now, can we?|Dooku, Grievous, and Quinlan Vos|''[[Dark Disciple]]''}} [[File:Dark_Disciple_Cover_Detail.jpg|thumb|right|226x226px|Vos and Ventress infiltrated the ceremony at the CIS capital.]] Grievous was later seen with Dooku on the Separatist capital planet of [[Raxus Secundus]] where Dooku was receiving the [[Raxian Humanitarian Award]]. Grievous was in charge of security, and he briefly [[Mission to assassinate Count Dooku|fought]] [[Quinlan Vos]], who was there on orders of the [[Jedi Council]] to kill Dooku. Vos ambushed the general and his droids to prevent them from assisting Dooku, who was under attack by Ventress, Vos's partner in the assassination. Even as Grievous rushed for the two lightsabers at his waist, Vos seized them with the Force before he could, and, as the [[Kiffar]] Jedi had predicted, Grievous bellowed and charged. Stepping aside almost leisurely, Vos cut upward, slicing off the general's left hand at the wrist [[Quinlan Vos's lightsaber|with his lightsaber]] as the two lightsabers flew into Vos's grip. The mechanical limb, with the [[comlink]] still clutched in its metal fingers, dropped to the floor. Suddenly, Grievous spread all four arms wide and charged, and Vos met him halfway. As they clashed in midair, Grievous was the heavier of the two, and his momentum drove them back toward the wall. He wrapped his right hands around Vos's throat and hurled him, attempting to slam him into the walkway's unforgiving stones. However, Grievous made the mistake of letting go, and Vos landed in an easy crouch. Vos warned Grievous to stay where he was, then locked the cyborg in a chamber before leaving. Grievous yelled and pounded his hand against the walls while one of the battle droids tried to open the door. After escaping the center security, Grievous emerged, and Vos immediately spun just in time to see him. He drove his boot into Dooku's [[stomach]], surprising the Count, before shifting his weight and kicking Grievous with his other foot. The cyborg tumbled over the railing, dragging Ventress down with him. As the two plunged downward, Ventress landed hard on a lower-level ledge, her head dangling over the edge. Grievous stood over her with one foot on her throat before grabbing her with all four hands and hurling her down to the level below. Ventress slammed against the wall beside one of the windows, collapsed onto the ledge, and endured a brutal beating. Suddenly, Grievous leaped toward her, but she turned to face him and rolled to the right. Despite being injured, disoriented, and without [[Asajj Ventress's lightsaber|her lightsaber]], Ventress charged at Grievous, delivering a barefoot kick that still managed to send the larger, heavier cyborg reeling backward. He growled, apparently taken aback. Ventress reached out through the Force to seize Vos's lightsaber, jumped down to the lower level, and began reducing the battle droids to scrap. She deflected blaster bolts into one droid, sliced through another, and kicked a third off the ledge. Turning her attention back to the general, she watched as he reached for his lightsabers, only to discover they were missing. Grievous then ordered his battle droids to detain her while he went to assist the Count. Shortly afterward, Grievous returned with reinforcements. Vos was captured, and Ventress escaped. ===Operation: Titan=== {{Quote|General Yoda… what a pleasure it is to see you here. This will be a unique privilege… did you know that I was trained in lightsaber combat by none other than Count Dooku? Your former student, I believe.''"
"''A lightsaber is a Jedi's weapon. Fit to wield it, you are not.''"
"''Then take it from me… if you can.|General Grievous and Yoda|[[Yoda 7|''Yoda'' 7]]}} Sometime after,The third arc of ''[[Star Wars: Yoda]]'' features [[Agen Kolar]] on the [[Jedi High Council]]. "[[A Seat on the Council]]" establishes that Kolar replaced [[Eeth Koth]], who served on the Council during [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|''The Clone Wars'': The Lost Missions]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of "[[The Wrong Jedi]]" to [[19 BBY]]. ''Galactic Atlas'' also dates the beginning of [[Great Jedi Purge]], which includes the events of "[[Victory and Death]]," to 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} places ''The Lost Missions'' between "The Wrong Jedi" and "Victory and Death", dating the events of ''The Lost Missions'' to 19 BBY. Kolar was later seen on the Council during {{Film|III}}, the events of which ''Galactic Atlas'' also dates to 19 BBY, including the [[Operation: Knightfall|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order]], limiting Kolar's tenure, and ''[[Star Wars: Yoda: Size Matters Not]]'', to that year. General Grievous was involved in a project that oversaw the construction of a new type of battle droid and superweapon that would be known as [[Megadroid]], these droids would be manufactured on the planet [[Golatha]] before being unleashed during the Clone Wars. The project was dubbed [[Operation: Titan]]. Arriving at a Separatist base on [[Enthenium]], Grievous was informed of the state of the [[Golatha factory|factory]] in Golatha and that the new droids would be able to commence field tests by the end of the week before seemingly leaving. The general soon returns only to find Jedi Master [[Yoda]] using one of the base's computers to gain some insight into the secret project. [[File:GrievousYodaDuel-Yoda7.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Grievous confronts Master Yoda on Enthenium.]] Greeting the Jedi Master, the Kaleesh cyborg ignited his saber and commented on how it was a pleasure to meet him after being trained by Yoda's former student, Count Dooku. Grievous learned that the [[Grand Master|Grand Jedi Master]] was a skilled swordsman with quite a reputation and hoped to meet him one day in combat, and that moment had finally arrived. Grievous was told by Yoda that a lightsaber is a weapon for Jedi, and he was unfit to use one, then [[Mission to Enthenium|engaged in a duel]] with the elderly Jedi. Pointing out the disadvantage that Yoda had with his small size, the general was quickly proven wrong after the Jedi Master jumped over him and landed a strike on his head. He regarded the mark that was left on his faceplate's forehead as a lucky strike that could be easily repaired after he would take the Jedi's head from his shoulder. While Grievous continued to engage, Yoda [[Force Stasis|froze]] him in place with the Force, claiming that despite using Jedi weapons, he lacked the same abilities and connection to the Force as all Jedi before pushing him into the wall. After colliding with the wall, the cyborg stood up unharmed and continued his duel with Yoda before his army of battle droids interrupted him and tried to shoot the Jedi Master while unintentionally giving him time to jump into a conduit and escape after stealing Grievous's lightsaber with the Force. Unfortunately, Yoda was able to successfully escape the separatist base and return to the Jedi with information on Operation: Titan. ===Campaign against the Shadow Collective=== ====Destroying Maul's forces==== {{Quote|Deploy our infantry -- every last soldier. We are not fighting clones this time. These are Mandalorian warriors...The odds are stacked against us!|Grievous estimating their chances of winning the battle|[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 1]]}} After [[Zabrak]] [[Nightbrothers|Nightbrother]] Maul had [[Escape from the Spire|escaped]] from Sidious, unknowingly falling into his plan to lure out and destroy Talzin, and was tracked to the [[Death Watch]]-controlled moon of [[Zanbar]], Grievous was ordered by Dooku to hunt down Sidious' former apprentice. Dooku then ordered him to direct his entire droid fleet at Maul's recently formed crime syndicate—the [[Shadow Collective]] and ordered him to destroy his army and wound his pride, but not to kill him. This was in order for him to draw out Mother Talzin, Maul's mother and one of the most powerful beings in the galaxy. Grievous thought it foolish to keep Maul alive, but Dooku reminded Grievous that it was not wise to question the plans of Darth Sidious, and that he as Dooku's apprentice would carry out his orders to the fullest degree. Grievous then moved his fleet to Zanbar and launched several landing craft to destroy the [[Mandalorian warrior]]s, starting off the [[Battle of Zanbar]]. [[File:DarthMaulGrievousDuel.png|thumb|right|230px|Maul and Grievous engage in battle.]] Basing his calculation on their experience compared to the clones they normally fought, Grievous knew that the chances of his droid army gaining a victory in this battle were unlikely. Deploying his droids after telling them as such, Grievous watched the fighting unfold from a landing craft until he spotted Maul on the battlefield. After sending out four of his IG-100 MagnaGuards to weaken Maul, Grievous emerged from his ship and engaged at least one [[Mandalorian super commando]] in battle, easily killing him with his lightsabers. Maul disposed of the MagnaGuards and turned his attention to the cyborg general and engaged Grievous in single combat. Neither Maul nor Grievous was able to gain the upper hand in the duel, but Grievous, per his orders, taunted Maul, telling him that the battle was lost. However, Maul had held several [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|Gauntlet fighters]] in reserve and ordered them to drop firebombs onto the battlefield. This left both factions' resources almost depleted. Maul, realizing Zanbar was lost, fled into a Gauntlet fighter and retreated from Grievous. Grievous then contacted Count Dooku via hologram and informed him he had fulfilled his master's wishes; Maul was on the run. Dooku then congratulated Grievous. Maul now believed the Sith were out to destroy him and his Syndicate, but would not learn of their true intentions until it was too late. Grievous knew their goal was the [[Dathomirian|witch]] Talzin, but did not understand what value Maul held for the Witch. Dooku told him all would be revealed as their plans unfolded. ====Captured by Maul==== {{Quote|Once our droids take control of the city, Maul's forces will be insects under our heels!|Grievous during the battle|[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 2]]}} [[File:CIS_Orbital_Bombardment_SoD.png|thumb|left|239x239px|Grievous orders for his ships to fire.]] After leaving Zanbar, Dooku rendezvoused with Grievous, gathering the fleet after Separatist spies reported that Mandalorian warships were amassing on the planet of [[Ord Mantell]], confirming Maul was in league with the [[Black Sun]] who controlled the planet. Grievous once again questioned the Dark Lord's obsession with destroying Mother Talzin; Dooku explained to Grievous that Talzin was an older and fouler creature than Grievous understood, and that she would have to be destroyed before she disrupted Darth Sidious' plans. Grievous' [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[Tey-Zuka]] reported to the cyborg general that a [[Talzin's shuttle|lone transport shuttle]] had left Dathomir moments ago, with Ord Mantell being a possible destination. Dooku believed Talzin was aboard and ordered the fleet to move to Ord Mantell. Soon they arrived and Grievous ordered the fleet to begin bombarding the [[Ord Mantell City|city]] from orbit. With the city now in ruins, the landing crafts began their assault. Grievous believed Maul's forces would soon be on the run but became suspicious when he realized he had not seen any Mandalorian warships. Tey-Zuka calculated that they had been destroyed before they could lift off but Grievous knew better—they were planning a sneak attack. The Gauntlet fighters appeared from behind Ord Mantell's moon, [[Battle on Ord Mantell|attacking]] the Separatist fleet. Grievous had been lured into a trap. Tey-Zuka reported a fighter had attached itself to the [[hull]] of Grievous' ''Providence''-class Dreadnought—but before the droid could finish, Maul interrupted. He gave Grievous an ultimatum; either he shut down the battle droids that were killing his troops—or he would die. With the general dismissing his threats, Maul then charged Grievous, tackling him into a [[transparisteel]] viewport. Dooku had also been captured as well. Maul contacted Sidious via hologram after traveling to [[Vizsla Keep 09]], threatening to kill them both unless he met Mother Talzin's demands. Sidious refused, instead stating he had no further use for them. Maul decided not to kill them, but ordered Grievous to the brig. Grievous told Dooku that it would be unfortunate if the next time they met he would have to add [[Dooku's lightsaber]] to his collection.[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]] Dooku, who was still on the bridge of the ship, later used the Force to unlock Grievous' cell. Grievous escaped, killing the Mandalorians that were guarding him and several more while searching for a way off the ship. He soon found an escape pod, ejecting from the carrier and escaping from Maul. ====Confronting Talzin==== {{Quote|It is just as you predicted, my Lord...we've traced Count Dooku's signals to Dathomir's surface. What is your command?|Grievous to Darth Sidious just before the battle|[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]]}} Shortly afterward, Grievous regrouped with Darth Sidious aboard the ''[[Scimitar]]''; which was originally Maul's personal starship; and they made their way to Dathomir where Dooku's signals were emanating from; just as Sidious predicted. Sidious ordered Grievous to [[Cloaking device|cloak]] the ship from view and make their way to Dathomir's surface. They landed and the pair approached a chamber said to hold a stone column that was the heart of Mother Talzin's power. The chamber was located very near the [[Nightbrother village]] where Maul was born. Grievous blew an opening in the wall of the chamber, entered and stated he was about to kill Maul. Sidious followed, stating only the Dark Lord's plan shall rule the galaxy. Dooku appeared, though he was now [[Possession|possessed]] by Talzin, who at the time was still unable to take physical form. [[File:Grievous_Owns_Talzin.png|thumb|right|225px|Grievous executes Talzin.]] The four [[Second Battle of Dathomir|engaged]] in lightsaber combat; Grievous attacked Maul while Sidious freed his apprentice from Talzin with the use of [[Force lightning]]. Talzin returned in the flesh while Sidious told her she was going to die here. Maul took advantage of this distraction and used the Force to shove Grievous through the opening the explosion had created. Sidious attacked Talzin with a Force lightning barrage while Talzin defended Maul and herself with [[magick]] as her son implored her to fight on. Dooku recovered and strengthened his master's assault against the witch. Knowing that escaping was impossible, Talzin threw Maul into his ship over his desperate objections. Grievous reentered the chamber calmly striding towards the now beaten Talzin; Grievous then ignited his lightsabers and bypassed her defenses and plunged them through the witch's chest, killing her for the second and final time{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Databank A-Z}} and ending her renewed quest for ultimate power. As the Droid Army attacked the nearby [[Unidentified Nightbrother village|Nightbrother village]], Darth Sidious took a moment to congratulate Dooku and Grievous; Maul's future had been erased while theirs was more certain than it had ever been. At some point following these events,{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} {{C|version archived on [[June 29]], [[2017]]; now replaced}} the Confederacy launched an [[Second battle of Christophsis|effort]] to retake the planet Christophsis as revenge for its previous defeat.{{Databank|christophsis-history-gallery|Christophsis History Gallery}} {{C|Image caption 13}} Because of how personal winning the planet was to Dooku, Ventress suspected that Grievous would be involved in the battle. Having allied with the Jedi and the rescued Quinlan Vos to try and kill Dooku again, she informed the Jedi Council of such, but their efforts ended in failure when Dooku escaped and Ventress, acting to save Vos from being struck by Force lightning, appeared{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} to be mortally wounded. Grievous rescued Dooku, but Vos had redeemed himself.{{SW|url=quinlan-vos-biography-gallery|text=Quinlan Vos Biography Gallery}} {{C|Image caption 14}} ===The final days=== ====Fighting Billaba==== {{Quote|You and your Jedi whelp ''die'' today, Billaba.''"
"''We shall see, ''Grievous'', we shall see.''"
"''I defeated you once before. My mistake was not confirming your death. It is not an error I intend to repeat.|General Grievous and Depa Billaba|}} [[File:Grievous-Kanan9.png|thumb|left|190px|Grievous realized he would need to deal with the Jedi himself.]] Six months after his victory over Billaba, [[Rackham Sear]] and General [[Kleeve]] discuss a plan to attack the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and destroy its central tower, having paid the [[Duros]] bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]],[[Kanan 8|''Kanan'' 8]] who had [[Raid on the Jedi Temple|infiltrated]] the temple three years earlier,for the necessary information. While Kleeve opposed Sear's idea and considered it a suicide mission, Grievous backed Rackham, praising his patriotism and arguing that, if the tower fell, both the Republic and the Separatists would realize that neither the Jedi Order nor the Republic was invincible, thus changing the course of the war. He and Kleeve then sent their top explosives expert, Captain Rackham Sear, to carry out the [[Bombing at the Jedi Temple|bombing]] of the Jedi Temple. After Captain Sear's mission failure, Grievous then went to [[Kardoa]] with Kleeve and Sear's brother, [[Colonel]] [[Coburn Sear]]. There, Grievous saw Billaba [[Skirmish on Kardoa|leading]] the [[Depa Billaba's second battalion|Republic forces]]. Grievous then demanded that she must die. However, Kleeve saw his obsession with killing Jedi as a distraction and warned against attacking before he left for [[Kaller]]. Grievous left as well for [[Mygeeto]]. However, he left Colonel Sear to deal with Billaba and her forces. Grievous then waited for Billaba and her forces to arrive on Mygeeto. There, he and Colonel Sear [[Third Battle of Mygeeto|confronted]] Billaba and her apprentice, [[Kanan Jarrus|Caleb Dume]]. Grievous quickly overwhelmed the Republic forces with dozens of battle droids after demolishing the [[Southern Mesas|mesa bridges]], but the [[Fang-class Protectorate fighter|Fang fighters]] of [[Skull Squadron]], led by [[Skull Leader]] [[Fenn Rau]], destroyed the attacking droids. After killing a [[Stance|nearby clone trooper]], Sear confronted Dume, while Grievous engaged Billaba in another lightsaber duel. Wielding two lightsabers,[[Kanan 10|''Kanan'' 10]] he struck at her repeatedly, convinced that he had already defeated her once and would not repeat the mistake of failing to confirm her death. Billaba parried every blow, declared that she was no longer the same person as before and now believed herself capable of defeating him, and knocked Grievous back with a Force push. He reappeared from behind her with two more blades and attacked, holding two aloft while sweeping the other two low in an attempt to strike her down. However, she parried the assault and severed two of Grievous's lower hands [[Depa Billaba's lightsaber|with her lightsaber]]. Grievous then severely injured Billaba, slashing her from behind. Despite her wounds, she continued fighting until Dume, Commander [[Styles]], and Captain [[Grey (clone trooper)|Grey]] arrived to aid her. Grey and Styles opened fire on the general, but he deflected their blaster bolts by spinning two of his lightsabers while Dume rushed to Billaba's side. Grievous forced a retreat before Billaba and Dume could attempt to surround him from behind, continuing to deflect the clones' blaster fire as he withdrew. Sliding down from the structure with his lightsabers, he regretted allowing her to live before leaving Mygeeto with the Republic. After the cyborg fled, Billaba had long since learned to live with remorse and did not order a pursuit. ====Hiding the Separatist Council==== {{Quote|He is here. We are being held hostage. They are watching us. ''[…]'' Tenth level. Thousands of battle droids.|Tion Medon, on Grievous' occupation|}} Much to the disappointment of the [[Utapaun]]s, who they had hoped the prior defeat of General Grievous and the loss of the kyber crystal would restore relative obscurity to their world,{{HelmetCollectionCite|25|Highlights of the Saga}} [[Separatist high command]] decided to seek refuge on Utapau{{EncyclopediaCite|Saw Gerrera and Other Characters of the Galaxy}} when Grievous chose the planet as a hiding place for the Executive Separatist Council.[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] With it decided, Darth Sidious commanded key Separatist leaders to gather there. Within months of the arms deal,{{HelmetCollectionCite|61|Databank A-Z}} in the final weeks of the Clone Wars, Grievous returned, this time with an invading force,{{BuildR2Cite|40|Droid Directory}} along with the ''Soulless One'', commanding thousands of battle droids and a detachment of MagnaGuards, and led the secret [[invasion of Utapau]],{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic and Separatist Ships (2)}} and during this invasion, the [[General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike|TSMEU-6 wheel bike]] was the general's preferred vehicle.{{Databank|general-grievous-tsmeu-6-wheel-bike|General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike}} Grievous and his forces invaded their peaceful world, forcing their leaders to cooperate. He was unwilling to face opposition from the planet's ruling [[Utapaun Committee]] and ordered his MagnaGuards to kill all of their members, much to [[Tion Medon]]'s horror. With the threat of immediate destruction over [[Pau'an]]s and [[Utai]], the [[Port Administrator]] had no choice but to comply with Grievous's demands, and a small Confederate base in Pau City was established by Grievous, where, under orders from Sidious, the Separatist Council was safely hidden. Before long, a massively modified [[core ship]] had taken over much of the city's [[level 10]], serving as the command headquarters for the Separatist droid forces.{{SWE|locations|utapau|Utapau}} ====Outer Rim Sieges==== =====CIS on the brink===== Ultimately, the Republic held all the momentum for the third year of the war. Despite Grievous's successes on Dathomir, Florrum, and elsewhere, the Separatists lost the majority of their droid factories and territory, pushing them to the Outer Rim. In the campaign known as the [[Outer Rim Sieges]], the Republic Military kept up the pressure.''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' Several key Separatist worlds were blockaded as droids and clones clashed throughout the Outer Rim,{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} with fronts also able to be opened in the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] and [[Colonies]].{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} During the sieges, Grievous attempted to take control of the [[Anaxes shipyards|shipyards]] on the planet [[Anaxes]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Droid Tanks and Vehicles, and Other Mechanicals}} on the Coreward edge of the Outer Rim, where the Republic owned a number of important [[shipyard]]s. Grievous's desire led to a protracted,{{EncyclopediaCite|Droid Tanks and Vehicles, and Other Mechanicals}} (English version) [[Battle of Anaxes|costly battle]] carried out by the [[Harch]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]], who dispatched [[Trench's army|droid forces]] and attacked the Republic shipyards.{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}} However, the conflict ended in a total defeat for the CIS, with Trench himself killed, his forces wiped out, and the Anaxes shipyards secured by the Republic.{{TCW|Unfinished Business (episode)}} Additionally, Grievous played a decisive role in the outbreak of conflict between the [[Wookiee]]s and the CIS after his battle droids used excessive force to convince the Wookiees to join the Separatists. Although the Separatists had already undertaken several small campaigns on the planet, they ultimately made the decision to concentrate their efforts on [[Kachirho]], a coastal city in the [[Wawaatt Archipelago]] surrounded by freshwater lakes. Grievous and the Separatists were interested in [[Kashyyyk]] in general, and Kachirho in particular, for another reason; Kachirho was a key place because it was simple to defend while also being an excellent landing strip for droids and was home to the [[Claatuvac Guild]] Archives, which contained many unknown space roads. Initially, the Wookiees attempted to remain neutral in the conflict, but the importance of the planet compelled both sides to enter into a series of negotiations with the [[Kashyyyk royal families|royal families]] of Kashyyyk to try and persuade them to join their cause. After a long wait for a favorable decision, Grievous became impatient and directed a large-scale attack, hoping the threat would "persuade" the Wookiees to accept the conditions posed by Dooku and his allies.{{HelmetCollectionCite|27|Highlights of the Saga}} (Spanish version) The decision, however, turned out to be a dire mistake for the Confederacy, and the Wookiees responded angrily, declaring an all-out war on the forces threatening to attack them, leading to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]]. The invasion and occupation began with a failed attack on the [[Kashyyyk oil refinery|oil refinery]] near Kachirho City in an attempt to cut off [[fuel]] supplies and reverse their declining fortunes in the war with help from the Claatuvac Guild's information. For the conflict, Confederacy allied with the Wookiees' Trandoshan enemies and deployed a secret force of battle droids along with warships. At some point, Grievous loaned one of the lightsabers from his personal collection to Separatist propaganda agents, who used it to make a fake hologram that was meant to stir up hatred against the Jedi.''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'' Towards the end of the war, the [[Crispus Commons bomb shelter]] was constructed in the unlikely event Grievous or Dooku would try to destroy the [[Crispus Commons]] veteran facility on the planet [[Gorse]].[[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']] =====Last grasp===== [[File:Grievous-led-Outer-Rim-Sieges.png|thumb|right|300px|General Grievous orders the Separatist Army to besiege the Outer Rim, forcing the deployment of numerous Jedi Generals all around the Outer Rim.]] With the Separatists on the verge of losing the war, a major victory was required to break the Republic's will and the momentum of their attacks. Then, Dooku informed Grievous with the news that he was expecting; Darth Sidious had obtained the coordinates for Grievous and his fleet to leap from the Outer Rim directly to Coruscant, as well as a plan to kidnap the Supreme Chancellor. Grievous was given the opportunity to strike a decisive blow by moving the fight to the heart of the Republic. He headed to the galactic capital. While Coruscant remained well-defended, its fleet was depleted by the need to divert forces to the Outer Rim Sieges. To the Republic, a surprise attack seemed impossible with the Separatists occupied in the Outer Rim and the [[Nexus Route]] coordinates firmly locked away, preventing the Separatists from striking directly at the capital. However, by sharing the coordinates with Palpatine, the Jedi Order had unknowingly delivered the secret directly to their enemy.{{EncyclopediaCite|The End of the Clone Wars}} With a strike at Coruscant possible, the CIS had a chance to recover and emerge victorious. Gathering his forces for an attack on the Core's heart, Grievous thought that such an attack would cause the recall of Republic forces participating in the Outer Rim Sieges, therefore removing or at least rendering the blockades permeable. It was a risky gamble that, if successful, could signal the end of the conflict. Despite the pressure put upon the CIS and the losses it had sustained, Grievous marshalled his forces for a counterattack and began his own offensive across the Outer Rim. His counteroffensive pushed the Republic's forces outside the Core, already stretched across the Outer Rim in the Republic's own offensive,{{BustCollectionCite|31|Star Wars Universe}} to a breaking point.
